66224.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀九格圖：CD19+ B 細胞（藍色）約占淋巴球 79%，FMC7 強陽性、CD11c 異質性部分陽性，但 CD25、CD103、CD123 皆陰性；此組合用來排除毛細胞白血病（HCL 需 CD11c/CD25/CD103/CD123 陽性），支持脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: CD45-bright, low SSC lymphocyte gate (63.8%) with CD19-positive B cells (blue) forming 78.6% of lymphocytes
B cells are FMC7 bright positive
CD11c heterogeneous, ranging from negative to moderately positive (partial expression)
CD25 negative, CD103 negative and CD123 negative on the B-cell population
Non-B lymphocytes (orange) and monocytes (gray) serve as internal controls
66224.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows a dominant CD45-bright, low side scatter lymphocyte population composed predominantly of CD19-positive B cells. The B cells are brightly FMC7 positive with heterogeneous partial CD11c expression, and are negative for CD25, CD103 and CD123. The absence of CD25, CD103 and CD123 argues against classic hairy cell leukemia, and the CD103-negative phenotype also argues against hairy cell leukemia variant. Light chain restriction is not shown in this panel. Combined with the CD23-negative, CD200-low profile and villous lymphocyte morphology, findings are compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HCL co-expresses bright CD11c, CD25, CD103 and CD123 (score 3-4), whereas this population is negative for CD25, CD103 and CD123.

ddx.dx: Splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli (HCL variant)
ddx.vs: This entity is CD11c+ and CD103+ but CD25- and CD123-, so the CD103 negativity here favors SMZL.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL has a similar CD25-/CD123- phenotype, often CD103 partial and IgG+, and is best separated by red pulp-predominant splenic histology and cyclin D3 expression.
CLL is typically FMC7 negative with dim CD20/CD22 and CD23/CD200 positivity, unlike this FMC7-bright population.

66160.recognize_zh: 低倍（4x）骨髓切片中，高細胞密度的造血組織內穿插大片淡粉紅色、較淡染的片狀區域，與深紫色的造血細胞區交錯成地圖狀，淡色區為 Gaucher 細胞與組織球的間質性浸潤，脂肪幾乎消失。
features: Low-power bone marrow trephine core with thin bony trabeculae
Markedly hypercellular marrow space with little residual fat
Broad pale pink interstitial to confluent sheets of large cells (Gaucher cells/histiocytes) alternating with darker purple hematopoietic areas
Geographic pattern of infiltration without discrete granulomas at this magnification
Cellular detail not resolvable at 4x
66160.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with markedly reduced fat. There is extensive interstitial to sheet-like infiltration by pale pink-staining large cells arranged in a geographic pattern, alternating with darker residual hematopoietic areas. Cytologic detail is not assessable at this magnification. In the stated context, the pale infiltrate corresponds to Gaucher cells and histiocytes, and higher-power examination with PAS, CD68 and enzyme or genetic testing (glucocerebrosidase activity, GBA1) is required for confirmation.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells occur in a background of the underlying neoplasm (e.g., myeloid hyperplasia or plasma cell sheets) with normal glucocerebrosidase activity.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection with foamy histiocytes (e.g., MAC in HIV)
ddx.vs: Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes are acid-fast positive with striated but granular cytoplasm and clinical immunosuppression.
Mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular or perivascular with spindle cells, eosinophils and fibrosis, and are tryptase and CD117 positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with desmoplasia and atypical nuclei and is cytokeratin positive rather than CD68 positive.

65968.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中漿細胞內外充滿大小不一、圓形玻璃樣嗜伊紅色小球（Russell bodies），CD138 包圍這些空泡狀細胞，λ 輕鏈 ISH 強陽性而 κ 弱，抹片上漿細胞含淡藍色圓形包涵體，符合 λ 限制性漿細胞腫瘤合併大量 Russell bodies。
features: Panel A: normocellular marrow biopsy with scattered cells containing round pink globules
Panel B: plasma cells distended by multiple round, glassy, homogeneous eosinophilic globules (Russell bodies) of varying size, displacing nuclei
Panel C: CD138 highlights the globule-containing plasma cells; inset MUM1 nuclear positivity
Panels D–E: lambda ISH strongly positive in plasma cells, with kappa largely negative/weak
Panel F: aspirate smear with plasma cells containing pale blue, round cytoplasmic inclusions (Mott cell-like)
65968.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is normocellular and contains an infiltrate of plasma cells distended by numerous round, homogeneous, glassy eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions of variable size, consistent with Russell bodies. Immunohistochemistry shows the plasma cells are CD138 and MUM1 positive, and in situ hybridization demonstrates lambda light chain restriction with minimal kappa signal. The aspirate smear shows plasma cells packed with pale blue, round cytoplasmic globules (Mott cell morphology). Findings are consistent with a lambda-restricted plasma cell neoplasm with prominent Russell body formation; classification depends on plasma cell percentage and clinical criteria.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells with Russell bodies are polytypic with a balanced kappa:lambda ratio, whereas this infiltrate is lambda restricted.
LPL has Dutcher bodies (intranuclear pseudoinclusions) with a small lymphocyte and plasmacytoid component and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.
In crystal-storing histiocytosis the immunoglobulin crystals lie within CD68-positive histiocytes, not CD138-positive plasma cells.
Signet ring cells contain mucin (mucicarmine/PAS positive) and express keratins rather than CD138 with light chain restriction.

65968.stain: H&E; IHC CD138, MUM1; ISH kappa/lambda; Giemsa

65648.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片以棕色色原標記 EBV：陽性訊號集中在少數散在的大型細胞，呈濃密、充滿整顆細胞的染色，周圍大量藍色小細胞為陰性；需注意部分陽性細胞體積大、核呈分葉，與巨核細胞形態重疊，判讀時要對照同一位置的 H&E。
features: Scattered large cells with dense brown chromogenic staining filling the cell outline
Positive cells are several times larger than background cells; some have lobulated contours
Numerous background small-to-intermediate hematopoietic and lymphoid cells are negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
Faint granular brown deposits in the interstitium
Staining pattern is global rather than crisp nuclear, limiting distinction from nonspecific uptake at this magnification
65648.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section stained for EBV shows scattered large cells with strong, dense brown staining, while the background hematopoietic and small lymphoid cells are negative. The positive cells are markedly larger than surrounding cells and some have lobulated outlines. The staining fills the whole cell rather than showing a discrete nuclear signal, and the size and shape of some positive cells overlap with megakaryocytes, so correlation with the H&E and a nuclear EBER in situ hybridization is advisable. In the reported context of large atypical cells on the aspirate, findings support EBV infection of large atypical cells, consistent with an EBV-associated lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are large with lobulated nuclei and can trap chromogen; true EBER positivity gives a crisp nuclear signal in cells that are morphologically lymphoid on H&E.
EBV-positive HRS cells in marrow sit in a fibrotic polymorphous background and express CD30 and CD15, whereas here CD30 is only scattered.
Bystander EBER-positive cells are rare small lymphocytes, not a population of large atypical cells.

65776.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中小型淋巴球胞質內有數個圓形清亮空泡，Oil Red O 陰性；免疫染色顯示空泡內含 kappa、IgM、IgG4，而 lambda 與 IgG 陰性，代表空泡是免疫球蛋白堆積，而非脂質。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant to moderate cytoplasm
Multiple sharply punched-out, round clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, some indenting the nucleus; Oil Red O negative (inset)
Core biopsy: hypercellular marrow with interstitial and nodular small lymphocyte infiltrate
Flow cytometry: kappa dim to negative B-cell population
Vacuoles visible on H&E sections and immunoreactive for kappa, IgM and IgG4, but not lambda or IgG (positive internal plasma cell controls in insets)
Similar vacuolated lymphocytes in pretreatment peripheral blood
65776.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows atypical small lymphoid cells with clumped chromatin and prominent round clear cytoplasmic vacuoles; an Oil Red O stain is negative, excluding lipid. The core biopsy is hypercellular with interstitial and nodular infiltration by small lymphocytes, and vacuoles are also discernible on H&E sections. Immunohistochemistry shows that the vacuoles contain kappa light chain, IgM and IgG4, but not lambda or IgG, with appropriately stained reactive plasma cells as internal controls. Flow cytometry confirms a CD5+/CD23+ kappa-dim B-cell population. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with immunoglobulin-containing cytoplasmic vacuoles.

ddx.vs: LPL shows plasmacytoid cells and eosinophilic PAS+ immunoglobulin inclusions with a CD5-negative/CD23-negative phenotype and MYD88 L265P, rather than clear vacuoles in CD5+/CD23+ small lymphocytes.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and lipid (Oil Red O-positive) vacuoles, CD10+ and CD5-negative.

ddx.dx: Lysosomal storage disease or Jordans anomaly
ddx.vs: Storage vacuoles occur in polytypic normal lymphocytes and neutrophils and are not light-chain-restricted immunoglobulin.
Artifactual vacuoles are small, irregular and not reproducible on sections, whereas these vacuoles persist on H&E and stain for immunoglobulin.

65776.stain: Wright-Giemsa; Oil Red O; H&E; IHC: Ig chains

65712.recognize_zh: 三個中至大型母細胞：核質比高、核圓或稍不規則、染色質細緻均勻，胞質淡藍；但此圖解析度有限，看不到明確的 Auer rod，單憑形態無法確認是骨髓系母細胞。
features: Three medium to large blasts, each larger than surrounding red cells
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclear contours
Fine, smooth, open chromatin with faint nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
No convincing Auer rods identified at this image resolution
65712.describe_en: Peripheral blood (or aspirate) smear shows three medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine dispersed chromatin and faint nucleoli, and scant to moderate pale blue cytoplasm. Definite Auer rods, which would confirm myeloid lineage, are not convincingly seen at this resolution, although the caption reports them. Morphology alone is therefore suggestive of acute leukemia with blasts compatible with myeloblasts, and lineage assignment requires MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts tend to be smaller with scant cytoplasm and less distinct nucleoli, and are MPO-negative and TdT/CD19 or CD3-positive on flow cytometry.
Monoblasts have more abundant grey-blue, sometimes vacuolated cytoplasm with round nuclei and are nonspecific esterase-positive.

ddx.dx: Large granular or activated reactive lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells.

64944.recognize_zh: 左側病人的 EDTA 紫頭管內血液呈凝膠狀、分層不均且底部有凝塊碎片，無法像右側對照管一樣正常流動與沉降；這種採血後立即在管內凝固/膠化的現象，提示冷凝球蛋白（cryoglobulin）在室溫下沉澱。
features: Gross photograph of two EDTA (lavender-top) vacutainers displayed upside down on their caps
Patient tube (left, arrow): blood forms a gelled, non-flowing column with dark upper portion and irregular clotted fragments near the cap
Control tube (right): uniformly anticoagulated blood with normal settling of red cells and a clear plasma layer above
No visible mixing or free-flowing liquid phase in the patient sample despite anticoagulant
64944.describe_en: Gross photograph of two EDTA-anticoagulated blood collection tubes. The patient sample (left) shows immediate gelation/clotting with an immobile column and irregular clot fragments, whereas the control sample (right) remains liquid with normal red cell sedimentation. In the context of a lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma with IgM paraprotein, this is consistent with cryoglobulin precipitation at room temperature; samples should be collected and transported at 37 °C for accurate counts and smear preparation. Findings are consistent with cryoglobulinemia-related in vitro sample gelation.

ddx.vs: A true clot from poor mixing does not re-liquefy on warming to 37 °C, whereas cryoglobulin gelation reverses with warming.

ddx.dx: Hyperviscosity from high-level IgM paraprotein without cryoprecipitation
ddx.vs: Hyperviscous blood flows sluggishly but remains liquid at room temperature and does not form a gel or clot-like mass.
Cold agglutinins cause visible red cell clumping/granularity that disperses on warming, rather than gelation of the whole plasma phase.

65456.recognize_zh: 兩顆分葉正常的嗜中性球，細胞質中布滿均勻、粗大的深紫紅色顆粒，但沒有空泡或 Döhle bodies，這是 Alder-Reilly 包涵體，不是毒性顆粒。
features: Two mature neutrophils with bilobed to trilobed nuclei
Cytoplasm diffusely filled with coarse, dark purple-red granules
Granules uniform in size and evenly distributed
No toxic vacuolation or Döhle bodies
Background red cells with scattered crenated forms (echinocytes, likely artifact)
65456.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature neutrophils with normally segmented nuclei and cytoplasm diffusely filled with coarse, uniform, dark purple-red granules. Cytoplasmic vacuoles and Döhle bodies are absent. The red cells show scattered crenated forms consistent with artifact. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly inclusions in neutrophils, suggestive of a mucopolysaccharidosis.

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation is finer and patchier, usually accompanied by vacuoles and Döhle bodies, and resolves with infection.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain a few giant irregular granules rather than numerous uniform coarse granules.
Pelger-Huët neutrophils have hypolobated nuclei with normal granulation, whereas these have normal lobation with abnormal granules.

65392.recognize_zh: 四格抹片中可見大量細胞質深藍、核偏位且帶核周淡染區的漿細胞，背景呈淡藍霧狀且紅血球疊成長串錢串狀（rouleaux），反映血中副蛋白增加。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and intensely basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Plasma cells of varying size, including larger forms with more open chromatin
One plasma cell with ragged cytoplasmic projections
Pronounced rouleaux formation with long red-cell stacks
Blue-gray, hazy background staining between cells
65392.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate fields show numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, varying from small mature forms to larger cells with less condensed chromatin. The red cells form long rouleaux stacks, and the background shows a hazy bluish tint consistent with increased plasma protein. Scattered neutrophils and lymphocytes are present. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with paraproteinemia.

ddx.vs: Also shows rouleaux and blue background but the infiltrate is lymphoplasmacytic with small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid cells and an IgM paraprotein.
Plasma cells are mature and polytypic, and electrophoresis shows a polyclonal rather than monoclonal increase.
Pseudo-rouleaux in thick areas disappears in the thin feathered edge, whereas true rouleaux persists there.

65200.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 可見中至大型淋巴瘤細胞，細胞核呈多葉、花瓣狀摺疊（flower-like nuclei），伴隨凋亡小體與核分裂；PAX5 與 CD10 陽性、CD3 陰性、Ki67 極高，確認為具花狀細胞形態的高惡度 B 細胞淋巴瘤，而非 ATLL。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Markedly convoluted, multilobated flower-like (cloverleaf) nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies; low-power field shows a vaguely mottled (starry-sky-like) pattern
Tumor cells PAX5+ (nuclear) and CD10+ (membranous), CD3- with only rare reactive T cells
Ki67 proliferation index approaching 90%, highlighting lobated nuclei
65200.describe_en: Sections of the maxillary sinus mass show diffuse effacement by sheets of intermediate to large atypical lymphoid cells with brisk mitotic activity and scattered apoptotic debris. At high power the neoplastic cells have strikingly lobated, flower-like nuclear contours with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm. By immunohistochemistry the tumor cells are PAX5 and CD10 positive and negative for CD3, with a Ki67 proliferation index of approximately 90%. Findings are consistent with a high-grade B-cell lymphoma (germinal center phenotype) with flower cell morphology; FISH/sequencing for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements is required for final classification.

ddx.vs: ATLL shares flower-like nuclei but is CD3+/CD4+/CD25+ and PAX5-, with HTLV-1 serology positive.
Burkitt cells are monotonous medium-sized with round nuclei and multiple small nucleoli, BCL2-negative and MYC-rearranged, lacking multilobated nuclei.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Morphology may overlap; distinction requires FISH demonstrating MYC plus BCL2 rearrangement, which was not found here.
Blastoid MCL is CD5+ and cyclin D1+/SOX11+ and usually CD10-, unlike this CD10+ cyclin D1- tumor.

65200.stain: H&E; IHC: CD3, PAX5, CD10, Ki67

64496.recognize_zh: 白血球極度增多，嗜中性系從骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核到分節核各階段都有（呈「骨髓像」的連續成熟譜），並可見一個嗜鹼性球，原始細胞不多，這是 CML 慢性期的典型抹片。
features: Marked leukocytosis with granulocytes at all stages of maturation
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes predominate alongside band and segmented neutrophils (myelocyte bulge)
Occasional promyelocytes/early forms with more basophilic cytoplasm; blasts not increased
Basophil with coarse dark granules obscuring the nucleus (upper center)
No dysplastic hypogranularity; granulocytes show normal granulation
Background red cells normochromic; some show artifactual refractile central inclusions
64496.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes spanning the full maturation spectrum, with prominent myelocytes and metamyelocytes together with band and segmented neutrophils. A basophil is present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Granulocytes show normal granulation without dysplasia. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies with a predominance of mature neutrophils and no basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 is negative.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypogranular, pseudo-Pelger cells) without basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL consists mainly of mature segmented neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and harbors CSF3R mutation.
Advanced disease shows increasing blasts (≥20% for blast phase) and marked basophilia (≥20%), not seen in this field.

64432.recognize_zh: 九個視野拼圖中，背景幾乎看不到游離血小板，僅存的血小板（多為大型／巨大血小板）全都緊貼在分葉中性球的細胞膜旁，即血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism）。
features: Collage of nine fields: segmented neutrophils each with one to two platelets adherent to the cell membrane
Adherent platelets are large to giant, some approaching red cell size, with fine azurophilic granules
Near-total absence of free platelets in the background
Neutrophils otherwise morphologically normal without toxic changes or phagocytosed platelets
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes
64432.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (collage of nine fields) shows marked thrombocytopenia with virtually no free platelets in the background. The few remaining platelets, many of which are large to giant forms, are adherent to the surface of segmented neutrophils, forming rosette-like satellites; platelet phagocytosis is not evident. Neutrophils and red cells are otherwise unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism in the setting of true severe thrombocytopenia due to immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Pseudothrombocytopenia shows free platelet aggregates at the feathered edge with a normal count in citrate, whereas here platelets are singly adherent to neutrophils and low in both EDTA and citrate.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within cytoplasmic vacuoles inside the neutrophil, whereas satellite platelets sit on the outer cell membrane.
MYH9 disorders show giant platelets free in the background with Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and no platelet rosetting.

ddx.dx: Overlying platelets by chance on a thick smear
ddx.vs: Random overlap involves occasional cells in thick areas, while satellitism is consistent around most neutrophils across the smear.

64368.recognize_zh: 厚片區可見成片大型細胞，細胞質豐富、灰藍色並帶條紋狀纖維紋理，核小而偏心，符合 Gaucher 細胞；此張較厚且染色偏藍，「皺紙樣」紋理不如薄片清楚。
features: Sheets of large cells with abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei with coarse chromatin
Faint fibrillary/striated cytoplasmic texture suggestive of crumpled tissue paper
Scattered clear vacuoles and admixed hematopoietic cells within the thick particle
Thick, heavily stained area limits assessment of individual cell detail
64368.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a thick cellular particle with sheets of large histiocytic cells. These cells have small eccentric nuclei and abundant blue-gray cytoplasm with a faint striated, fibrillary texture, admixed with residual hematopoietic cells and scattered vacuoles. The thickness and intense staining of this area limit evaluation of individual cell outlines. Findings are suggestive of Gaucher cells; confirmation with glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically near-identical, so separation relies on the clinical context, a normal glucocerebrosidase activity, and the presence of an underlying disorder.
Niemann-Pick cells have soap-bubble, uniformly vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillary crumpled-paper striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules that are Giemsa-blue, not diffusely striated cytoplasm.
MAC-laden histiocytes show negative-image striations that are acid-fast positive on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.

64176.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆中等大小淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質中度凝集，具有比一般小淋巴球更多的淡藍色細胞質，呈輕度漿細胞樣（plasmacytoid）外觀；形態不具特異性，需結合 IgM 單株蛋白與 MYD88 L265P 突變來診斷 Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than normal small lymphocytes
Round, slightly eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed, somewhat open chromatin
Moderate rim of pale blue, finely granular-appearing cytoplasm with lighter perinuclear zone
No nucleoli, cleft, or villous projections evident
Background red cells normocytic with central pallor; rouleaux not prominent in this field
64176.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with round, slightly eccentric nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and a moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm imparting a mildly plasmacytoid appearance. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without conspicuous rouleaux in this field. The morphology is nonspecific; in the context of an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P mutation, these cells are consistent with circulating lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells, and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.
SMZL cells often show polar villous cytoplasmic projections; overlap with LPL is resolved by MYD88 L265P and clinicopathologic correlation.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and a prominent hof, and are CD19-negative/CD138-positive.
CLL cells are smaller with scant cytoplasm and soccer-ball chromatin and are CD5+/CD23+.

64048.recognize_zh: PAX5 染色中，大型異型細胞的細胞核呈強而均勻的棕色核染色，小 B 淋巴球亦陽性，表示這些大細胞是 B 細胞系，支持大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Strong diffuse nuclear PAX5 staining of large atypical cells with large round nuclei
Smaller PAX5-positive nuclei of background B lymphocytes (lower right)
Nuclear rather than cytoplasmic localization, appropriate for a transcription factor
Scattered PAX5-negative stromal and T cells with blue counterstain
64048.describe_en: PAX5 immunohistochemistry shows strong, diffuse nuclear staining of the large atypical cells, which have enlarged round nuclei. Smaller background B lymphocytes are also positive, while stromal cells and presumed T cells are negative. The intensity in the large cells is comparable to that of normal B cells. Findings confirm B-cell lineage of the neoplastic cells and, with CD45 positivity, support a large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells show characteristically weak (dim) PAX5 nuclear staining compared with strong staining of reactive B cells, unlike the strong staining here.
Carcinomas are PAX5 negative, although Merkel cell and some neuroendocrine carcinomas can be PAX5 positive and require keratin/neuroendocrine markers.
B-lymphoblasts are PAX5+ but medium-sized with fine chromatin and TdT/CD34 expression, lacking the abundant cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli of these cells.

63920.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一群比周圍顆粒球大好幾倍的外來細胞，彼此黏聚成小團，核大且圓或凹凸不平、染色質顆粒狀並可見核仁，細胞質豐富淡藍色、呈泡沫狀且邊界不清，這種黏聚性大細胞團提示轉移性癌。
features: Clusters of large cohesive non-hematopoietic cells, several times the size of adjacent neutrophils
Large round to lobulated or indented nuclei with coarsely granular chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated to foamy cytoplasm with indistinct, frayed borders
Cells arranged in small groups and a loose sheet with overlapping nuclei
Background red cells, a few mature neutrophils and platelets; normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in this field
63920.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters and loose sheets of large, cohesive cells that are foreign to the marrow, in a background of red cells and scattered neutrophils. The cells have large round to lobulated nuclei with coarsely granular chromatin and small nucleoli, and abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm with ill-defined borders. Normal hematopoietic precursors are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic non-hematopoietic malignancy, and with the reported AE1/AE3 and TTF-1 positivity and CD45 negativity, are consistent with metastatic lung carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts are discohesive single cells with delicate lacy chromatin, nonspecific esterase positivity and CD45 expression, unlike cohesive keratin-positive clusters.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a distinct paranuclear hof away from the nucleus and occur in children or healing bone, and they are keratin negative.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or plasmablastic neoplasm
ddx.vs: These can mimic cohesive clusters but are CD45 or CD30/CD138 positive and keratin negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma from other sites (e.g. breast, GI, kidney)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so the TTF-1 positive, CDX2 negative, PSA negative immunoprofile is what assigns a lung primary.

63792.recognize_zh: 這是矢狀切面 CT（左）與 PET/CT 融合影像（右），多節胸腰椎椎體呈多發、片狀的高代謝攝取，提示骨髓多處受侵犯；本身不是形態學影像，需骨髓切片確認病因。
features: Sagittal CT (left) and fused FDG PET/CT (right) of the head, neck and trunk
Multifocal increased FDG uptake within multiple cervical, thoracic and lumbar vertebral bodies
No obvious lytic destruction or vertebral collapse on the CT window at this resolution
Additional foci of uptake in the upper abdomen, of uncertain organ localization on this single slice
Physiologic uptake in brain; image quality limited (photograph of monitor)
63792.describe_en: This figure is a sagittal CT image paired with a fused FDG PET/CT reconstruction rather than a morphologic specimen. The PET component shows multifocal hypermetabolic foci involving multiple vertebral bodies along the axial skeleton, without clear corresponding lytic lesions or collapse on the CT window at this resolution. Additional foci of uptake are seen in the upper abdomen. Multifocal hypermetabolic marrow lesions are nonspecific and may reflect granulomatous infection, lymphoma, myeloma, or metastatic disease, so targeted bone marrow biopsy with culture and special stains is needed; in this case the biopsy showed granulomatous inflammation.

ddx.vs: PET pattern can be identical; biopsy shows a monoclonal lymphoid infiltrate rather than epithelioid granulomas.
Often shows lytic lesions on CT and an M-protein, with biopsy showing clonal plasma cells.
Frequently has a known primary and sclerotic or lytic CT changes; biopsy shows keratin-positive tumor cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive diffuse marrow hypermetabolism (G-CSF, anemia recovery)
ddx.vs: Produces homogeneous uniform uptake across the skeleton rather than discrete multifocal lesions.

63728.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中充滿大小中等、核質比高、染色質細而均勻、胞質少且偏藍、無顆粒的原始細胞（blast），部分可見小核仁；箭頭處是一顆中期分裂相（mitotic figure），淡粉紅、破碎的污跡細胞也很多。無顆粒與 Auer 小體提示淋巴母細胞，但 B 系需靠流式確認。
features: Sheets of small-to-medium blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to slightly indented or oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scant, moderately basophilic agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods
Mitotic figure with condensed chromosomes arranged in a rosette/metaphase pattern (arrow)
Numerous disrupted smudged nuclei with pale pink reticulated chromatin (smear artifact)
Few residual normal hematopoietic cells in this field
63728.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly increased population of small to medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous to small nucleoli and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. A mitotic figure is present (arrow), and numerous smudged, disrupted nuclei are seen in the background. Residual normal hematopoiesis is markedly reduced in this field. The morphology is consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; B-lineage assignment requires flow cytometry (e.g., CD19, CD22, CD79a, CD10, TdT), and in this case is consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: T-ALL blasts look identical; flow showing cyCD3 and T-lineage antigens without B markers separates them.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts are also agranular but are CD13/CD33/CD117 positive and lack B-lymphoid antigens.
Hematogones show a maturation continuum of CD34, CD10, CD20 on flow and rarely form sheets replacing marrow.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles and are surface-light-chain positive, TdT and CD34 negative.

63664.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中骨髓被形態單一的小淋巴球片狀取代，核圓至卵圓、間距平均，周圍有清澈細胞質，呈「荷包蛋」（fried-egg）樣外觀；CD20 瀰漫強陽性，annexin A1 陽性，cyclin D1（BCL1）為弱核染色。
features: H&E: hypercellular marrow replaced by sheets of monotonous small lymphoid cells
Round to oval, evenly spaced nuclei with bland chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate clear to pale cytoplasm creating a 'fried-egg' pattern; interstitial extravasated red cells
CD20: diffuse strong membranous staining of the infiltrate
Annexin A1: weak to moderate cytoplasmic staining of lymphoid cells, stronger in scattered myeloid cells
BCL1 (cyclin D1): weak nuclear staining in a subset of cells
63664.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow extensively infiltrated by sheets of monotonous small lymphoid cells with round to oval, evenly spaced nuclei, bland chromatin, and moderate clear cytoplasm imparting a 'fried-egg' appearance, with interstitial extravasated erythrocytes. By immunohistochemistry the infiltrate is diffusely positive for CD20, shows cytoplasmic annexin A1 positivity (with strong staining of scattered myeloid cells as internal control), and weak nuclear cyclin D1 (BCL1) staining in a subset of cells. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; BRAF V600E testing (VE1 immunohistochemistry or molecular) can provide further confirmation.

ddx.vs: MCL shows strong uniform nuclear cyclin D1, CD5 positivity, and annexin A1 negativity, without the widely spaced fried-egg pattern.
SMZL shows a nodular or intrasinusoidal pattern and is cyclin D1 and annexin A1 negative.
HCL variant is annexin A1 and CD25 negative and lacks BRAF V600E.
Mast cell infiltrates can have clear cytoplasm but are CD117 and tryptase positive and CD20 negative.

63664.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, annexin A1, cyclin D1

63600.recognize_zh: A 圖為 CellaVision 影像庫，淋巴球核較大、部分染色質細緻，看似原始細胞；但 B 圖 CD45/SSC 的原始細胞區（blast gate）幾乎沒有細胞，C 圖可見 CD5+/CD19+ B 細胞群，E 圖 kappa 與 lambda 兩群皆存在（多株，polyclonal），故為反應性 CD5+ B1a 淋巴球增多而非白血病。
features: Panel A: gallery of lymphocytes with slightly increased cytoplasm, mostly condensed chromatin and a few cells with finer chromatin mimicking blasts
Panel B: CD45 versus side scatter shows cells concentrated in the bright CD45, low side scatter lymphocyte gate with an essentially empty blast gate
Panel C: CD5 versus CD19 within lymphocytes shows a distinct CD5+/CD19+ B-cell population alongside CD5+/CD19- T cells and double-negative cells
Panel D: CD5+/CD19+ cells are uniformly CD20 bright and CD45 bright
Panel E: CD5+/CD19+ B cells contain both kappa-positive and lambda-positive subsets, indicating polyclonality
63600.describe_en: Composite figure of peripheral blood morphology and flow cytometry. The CellaVision gallery shows lymphocytes with slightly increased cytoplasm and mostly condensed chromatin, a few with finer chromatin that could mimic blasts. On flow cytometry, events are concentrated in the bright CD45, low side scatter lymphocyte region with no increase in the blast gate, and a CD5+/CD19+ B-cell population is present that is bright for CD20 and CD45. Light chain analysis of this population shows both kappa and lambda-expressing cells, indicating polyclonality. Findings are consistent with a reactive, polyclonal CD5+ innate-like (B1a) B-cell lymphocytosis rather than a lymphoproliferative neoplasm or acute leukemia.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia / monoclonal B-cell lymphocytosis
ddx.vs: CLL/MBL cells are CD5+/CD19+ but show light chain restriction, dim CD20 and CD23 positivity, whereas this population is polyclonal and CD20 bright.
Mantle cell lymphoma is CD5+ with bright CD20 but is light chain restricted and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.
B-lymphoblasts fall in the dim CD45 blast gate and express CD34, TdT and CD10, which are absent here.
Hematogones show a maturation continuum with CD10 and TdT/CD34 on early stages and are CD5-negative.

63536.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒周圍有成片單一形態的細胞，細胞核卵圓偏位、細胞質豐富且布滿細小紫紅色顆粒（箭頭），部分顆粒稀疏、細胞邊界模糊，符合成片的腫瘤性肥大細胞（neoplastic mast cells）。
features: Sheets and clusters of medium-to-large mononuclear cells within and around marrow particles
Round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm containing fine purple metachromatic granules, frequently sparse (hypogranular) and unevenly distributed
Some cells with irregular or elongated cytoplasmic outlines; granules dispersed into the background (arrows)
Scattered admixed red cells and small numbers of residual hematopoietic cells
63536.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle with sheets of medium-to-large mononuclear cells largely replacing normal hematopoietic elements. The cells have round to oval, eccentric nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm containing fine purple granules that are often sparse and unevenly distributed, with granules spilling into the background (arrows). Normal mast cells are rare and round with densely packed granules, so the sheet-like distribution and hypogranularity are abnormal. Findings are consistent with infiltration by neoplastic mast cells in systemic mastocytosis; confirmation by tryptase/CD117 with aberrant CD25 or CD2 expression and KIT D816V testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are isolated, round, and densely granulated, rather than forming sheets of hypogranular cells with eccentric oval nuclei.
Plasma cells have deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof, whereas these cells carry fine purple granules.

ddx.dx: Basophilic proliferation (e.g., CML or basophilic leukemia)
ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented or lobulated nuclei with coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and are CD123+/tryptase-weak, while mast cells have round nuclei and are strongly tryptase and CD117 positive.

ddx.dx: Promyelocytes in APL or myeloid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Promyelocytes show nucleoli, a Golgi zone, and azurophilic granules with MPO positivity, while mast cell granules are metachromatic on toluidine blue and MPO negative.

63472.recognize_zh: A 格骨髓抹片見大片洋紅色、無結構的膠狀基質包圍脂肪空泡，造血細胞極少；B 格血塊切片見脂肪細胞變小、之間充滿淡灰粉紅色細纖維狀膠狀物與出血，造血細胞稀少，符合骨髓膠狀轉化（gelatinous transformation / serous fat atrophy）。
features: Two-panel composite: aspirate smear (A) and clot section (B), both at 20X
A: abundant amorphous magenta-purple extracellular matrix surrounding fat vacuoles, with very few hematopoietic cells
B: small, atrophic adipocytes of variable size separated by pale gray-pink, finely fibrillar gelatinous material
B: marked hypocellularity with only scattered hematopoietic cells and areas of extravasated red cells
No tumor cells, granulomas, or fibrosis identifiable in either panel
63472.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (A) shows abundant amorphous magenta extracellular material admixed with fat vacuoles and a marked paucity of hematopoietic elements. The corresponding clot section (B) shows atrophic adipocytes of varying size separated by pale, lightly eosinophilic to basophilic, finely fibrillar gelatinous substance, with scattered extravasated red cells and only rare hematopoietic cells. No infiltrative neoplasm or granulomatous inflammation is seen. Findings are consistent with gelatinous transformation of the bone marrow (serous fat atrophy); the material is expected to be Alcian blue positive and reticulin is not increased, and clinical correlation for malnutrition or cachexia is recommended.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows hypocellular marrow replaced by normal-sized mature adipocytes without extracellular gelatinous material or fat cell atrophy.
Edema shows clear interstitial fluid without mucopolysaccharide staining, and necrosis shows ghost cells and nuclear debris with eosinophilic granular background.

Amyloid is dense, glassy, and eosinophilic, typically perivascular, and is Congo red positive with apple-green birefringence, whereas gelatinous material is Alcian blue positive and Congo red negative.
Myelofibrosis shows increased reticulin/collagen with streaming cells and atypical megakaryocytes, while gelatinous transformation lacks reticulin fibrosis.

63344.recognize_zh: 一個大小約和紅血球差不多的圓形細胞，核佔幾乎整個細胞、染色質濃縮成塊，只剩一圈很薄的藍色胞質、沒有顆粒，這是正常小型成熟淋巴球。
features: Small round cell approximately the size of a red cell
Very high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with dense, coarsely clumped chromatin; no visible nucleoli
Scant thin rim of blue agranular cytoplasm
Background normochromic normocytic red cells
63344.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte approximately the size of an adjacent red cell, with a round nucleus, dense clumped chromatin, no visible nucleoli and a scant rim of agranular blue cytoplasm. Surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal small mature lymphocyte.

ddx.vs: LGLs are larger with moderate pale cytoplasm containing azurophilic granules.
CLL cells look similar individually but show soccer-ball chromatin, smudge cells and an absolute lymphocytosis on the whole smear.
Orthochromatic normoblasts have a pyknotic, very dark nucleus with pink-orange hemoglobinized cytoplasm.

63088.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片低倍（右）見紅血球緣錢狀排列（rouleaux）與藍染背景，漿細胞增多；高倍（左）見雙核、多核的異型漿細胞，以及細胞核上方有淡藍色圓形包涵體的漿細胞（Dutcher/Russell body 樣），這些都是漿細胞骨髓瘤的特徵。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Atypical binucleate and multinucleated (three- to four-lobed) plasma cells
Plasma cell with a pale blue, round, globular inclusion overlying the nucleus (Dutcher/Russell body-like)
Red cell rouleaux formation in stacked chains
Blue proteinaceous background staining
63088.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows prominent red cell rouleaux and bluish proteinaceous background staining at low power. Plasma cells are increased and include atypical binucleate and multinucleated forms. One plasma cell contains a pale, round globular inclusion overlying the nucleus, consistent with a Dutcher or Russell body. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; quantification of plasma cells and demonstration of clonality are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, polyclonal and usually <10% without multinucleation or rouleaux with blue background.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with Dutcher bodies and MYD88 L265P, rather than sheets of atypical multinucleated plasma cells.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters without a perinuclear hof, and megakaryocytes are much larger with granular cytoplasm and lobulated rather than separate nuclei.

62896.recognize_zh: 脂肪性骨髓中，大量小型細胞呈棕色細胞膜染色，散布於脂肪細胞間的間質、彼此間距較寬，呈毛細胞白血病典型的間質性 B 細胞浸潤；影像雖未標示抗體，依描述應為 CD20。
features: Hypocellular, fat-predominant marrow
Numerous small to medium cells with strong brown membranous/cytoplasmic staining in an interstitial pattern between adipocytes
Positive cells widely spaced, singly and in loose strands, without forming discrete nodules
Scattered negative (blue) hematopoietic nuclei interspersed
Bony trabecula edge at the upper right without paratrabecular aggregates
62896.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a hypocellular, fat-rich bone marrow core biopsy highlights numerous small to medium cells with membranous positivity, arranged as a widely spaced interstitial infiltrate between adipocytes. The positive cells do not form discrete nodules or paratrabecular aggregates, and negative hematopoietic cells are interspersed. The marker is not labeled on the image but, per the case description, corresponds to CD20. Findings are consistent with interstitial involvement by hairy cell leukemia; the extent of infiltration is better appreciated on immunostain than on H&E.

ddx.vs: SMZL shows nodular and intrasinusoidal CD20+ infiltrates and is annexin A1, CD25 and cyclin D1 negative.
MCL forms nodular or paratrabecular aggregates of CD5+, strongly cyclin D1+/SOX11+ cells.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with residual lymphoid cells
ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow contains only scattered polytypic B and T cells rather than a dense CD20+ interstitial infiltrate.

62960.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中嗜中性球細胞質內可見 1–2 個小而圓、邊界清楚、深紫色均質的包涵體（箭頭），大小與染色類似紅血球中的 Howell-Jolly body，出現在免疫抑制病人，稱為 Howell-Jolly body 樣包涵體。
features: Mature segmented neutrophils with one or two small, round, sharply defined, dense dark purple cytoplasmic inclusions (arrowheads)
Inclusions are homogeneous without internal granular or morula-like structure
Inclusions lie separate from the nuclear lobes, not attached as a drumstick
Cytoplasm with mild toxic granulation; some neutrophils with slightly hyposegmented nuclei
Background red cells with scattered echinocytes and normal platelets
62960.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature neutrophils containing one or two small, round, dense, dark purple cytoplasmic inclusions that are homogeneous and separate from the nuclear lobes. The neutrophils show mild toxic granulation. Background red cells include scattered echinocytes. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions in neutrophils, a finding associated with immunosuppressive therapy in this transplant recipient; infection (e.g. Anaplasma/Ehrlichia) should be excluded clinically.

ddx.vs: Morulae are larger, stippled, mulberry-like clusters of bacteria with a granular texture rather than a small, smooth, homogeneous dot.
A Barr body is attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin chromatin strand, whereas these inclusions lie free in the cytoplasm.
Dohle bodies are pale blue-gray, irregular peripheral cytoplasmic patches, not dense dark purple round dots.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed organisms or debris (e.g. Histoplasma, platelets)
ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo and a crescent nucleus, and ingested platelets are granular, unlike solid chromatin-like dots.

62832.recognize_zh: 拼圖 B 可見一顆明顯增大、帶有大型核內包涵體的細胞（CMV 細胞病變），插圖為 CMV 免疫染色陽性；E 的免疫染色只圈出濾泡周圍的一圈外套區（mantle zone）而中央生發中心陰性，顯示腫瘤細胞侷限於外套區生長——這是外套細胞淋巴瘤外套區型（mantle zone pattern）的線索，容易被 CMV 淋巴結炎的反應性表現掩蓋。
features: Composite of lymph node sections (A–F); antigens for panels C–F are not labeled in the image
A: low-power H&E lymph node with preserved nodular architecture; inset shows small-to-medium lymphoid cells
B: high-power H&E with a markedly enlarged cell containing a large amphophilic intranuclear inclusion (CMV cytopathic effect); inset shows an inclusion-bearing cell positive by immunostain
C: low-power immunostain with diffuse strong staining of most of the node surrounding paler nodules
D and E: immunostains outlining rings of positive cells around negative follicle centers, i.e., a mantle zone distribution
F: immunostain with numerous positive cells concentrated in a band around a follicle
62832.describe_en: Composite lymph node sections show, at low power, a node with preserved follicular/nodular architecture composed of small-to-medium lymphoid cells (A). High power reveals scattered markedly enlarged cells with large intranuclear inclusions consistent with cytomegalovirus cytopathic effect, confirmed by immunostaining of an inclusion-bearing cell (B, inset). Immunohistochemical stains (antigens not labeled in the figure) show positive cells arranged as expanded rings around negative germinal centers, highlighting a mantle zone growth pattern (C–F); confirmation of cyclin D1 or SOX11 positivity in these mantle cells is required to establish the diagnosis. In context, the findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with a mantle zone growth pattern co-occurring with CMV lymphadenitis.

ddx.dx: Reactive follicular hyperplasia with CMV lymphadenitis
ddx.vs: Reactive mantle zones are thin and polytypic and are cyclin D1 and SOX11 negative, whereas neoplastic mantle cells are cyclin D1 positive and light chain restricted.
In situ mantle cell neoplasm shows cyclin D1-positive cells confined to the inner mantle of otherwise normal-sized mantle zones, rather than expanded mantle zones or nodal effacement.
MZL cells surround follicles outside the mantle zone and are CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.
EBV-associated changes show immunoblasts that are EBER positive without intranuclear viral inclusions, which in this case are CMV positive.

62768.recognize_zh: 周邊血中出現有核紅血球（紅箭頭），鐵染色下這些有核紅血球的核周圍排列一圈藍色含鐵顆粒，即環形鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；旁邊無核的紅血球內也有散在藍色顆粒（藍箭頭，siderocyte / Pappenheimer bodies）。
features: Circulating nucleated red blood cells with dense pyknotic nuclei and polychromatic to orthochromatic cytoplasm (red arrows)
Prussian blue stain: nucleated red cells with coarse blue iron granules arranged in a perinuclear ring (ring sideroblasts)
Anucleate red cells containing clusters of blue iron granules (siderocytes; Pappenheimer bodies on Wright stain, blue arrows)
Background red cells with anisocytosis and polychromasia
A band neutrophil adjacent to a nucleated red cell on the Wright-stained field
62768.describe_en: Wright-stained peripheral blood smear shows circulating nucleated red blood cells with condensed nuclei, together with polychromasia and occasional red cells containing small basophilic inclusions consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. Prussian blue iron stain of the same specimen demonstrates coarse siderotic granules encircling the nuclei of nucleated red cells in a perinuclear ring, consistent with circulating ring sideroblasts, as well as siderocytes containing clustered iron granules. Findings are consistent with transient circulating ring sideroblasts and siderocytes in the setting of acute hemolysis; correlation with follow-up smears is needed to exclude an underlying sideroblastic process.

ddx.vs: MDS-RS shows persistent marrow ring sideroblasts with dyserythropoiesis and SF3B1 mutation, whereas these circulating ring sideroblasts are transient during acute hemolysis.
Congenital forms present with lifelong microcytic hypochromic anemia and a dimorphic red cell population rather than a transient finding with hemolysis.
Basophilic stippling consists of fine, evenly distributed RNA granules that are Prussian blue-negative, unlike the iron-positive granules seen here.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single round DNA remnants that are Prussian blue-negative, rather than multiple small iron granules.

62704.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央是一顆巨大異常漿細胞，胞質豐富、深藍色並偏心，內有多個核（多核或多葉核）；周圍漿細胞也大小不一、核質比高。本圖多核特徵較核仁更明顯，核仁在此焦距下不易辨認。
features: Large atypical multinucleated plasma cell in the center with at least five to six nuclei or nuclear lobes
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear area
Nuclei with finely granular to open chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved at this focus
Surrounding immature plasma cells of variable size with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Thick smear area with out-of-focus red cells limiting fine nuclear detail
62704.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased atypical plasma cells of variable size with eccentric nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. In the center is a large abnormal plasma cell with abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple nuclei or nuclear lobes with relatively open chromatin; distinct nucleoli are not clearly resolved in this thick, partially out-of-focus field, so the multinucleation is the more evident abnormality. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with atypical, multinucleated plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have many separate uniform nuclei with lighter granular cytoplasm, and megakaryocytes have a single lobulated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm, unlike this deeply basophilic cell with a perinuclear hof.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis with binucleate plasma cells
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small and mature with clock-face chromatin and only occasional binucleation, not large multinucleated forms with immature chromatin.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shows large immunoblastic cells with prominent single nucleoli and high proliferation, typically in immunodeficiency and often EBER-positive.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters of separate cells with distinct cell borders rather than a single cell with shared basophilic cytoplasm and plasmacytoid features.

62640.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小不一，可見數顆偏大、灰藍色的多染性紅血球（polychromasia，反映網狀紅血球增加），並有少數形狀不規則的紅血球，視野中無白血球、血小板散在；屬於溶血性貧血的非特異表現，PNH 需靠流式細胞確診。
features: Moderate anisocytosis with scattered macrocytes
Several larger blue-gray polychromatophilic red cells indicating reticulocytosis
Occasional irregular and teardrop-like poikilocytes; no definite schistocytes or spherocyte predominance
Most red cells normochromic with central pallor
Small platelets scattered in the background; no leukocytes in this field
62640.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisocytosis with scattered macrocytes and several larger blue-gray polychromatophilic red cells, consistent with reticulocytosis. Occasional irregular poikilocytes are present, but schistocytes, agglutinates and a predominance of spherocytes are not identified, and most red cells retain central pallor. Platelets are present in the background and no leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are nonspecific but compatible with a hemolytic process such as paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria, which requires confirmation by flow cytometry (FLAER, CD59).

ddx.vs: Shows numerous spherocytes with polychromasia and a positive direct antiglobulin test, whereas PNH is DAT-negative.
Features conspicuous schistocytes and marked thrombocytopenia.
Numerous uniform spherocytes lacking central pallor with a family history and increased osmotic fragility or reduced EMA binding.

62576.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E：小淋巴球之間夾雜成片的大型漿母細胞，細胞質豐富、嗜雙性，核大且呈泡狀、核仁明顯，部分核偏心並有核周空暈；這些大細胞聚集成群但未完全抹除結構，符合 HHV8 陽性親生發中心淋巴增生性疾病。
features: Clusters and sheets of large plasmablastic cells, several times the size of adjacent small lymphocytes
Abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, some with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof
Large round vesicular nuclei with prominent central nucleoli
Occasional binucleate forms and apoptotic bodies
Admixed and intervening small mature lymphocytes; a small capillary with red cells
62576.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows cohesive-appearing clusters and small sheets of large plasmablastic cells intermixed with small mature lymphocytes. The large cells have abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, sometimes with eccentric nuclei, and large round vesicular nuclei with prominent central nucleoli; occasional binucleate forms and apoptotic bodies are present. Mitotic figures are not conspicuous and there is no necrosis in this field. In the context of germinal-center localization, HHV8 LANA-1 and EBER co-positivity and a CD20-negative phenotype, the findings are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma shows diffuse effacing sheets with frequent mitoses and starry-sky pattern and is HHV8 LANA-1 negative.
Extracavitary PEL shows more pleomorphic, anaplastic cells infiltrating sinuses and paracortex rather than cells confined to germinal centers.
HRS cells are fewer, with bilobed nuclei and macronucleoli in a mixed inflammatory background, and are CD30+/CD15+ and HHV8 negative.
Carcinoma cells show true cohesion, are keratin positive and CD45/MUM1 negative, and usually involve the subcapsular sinus first.

62512.recognize_zh: 未圈選（ungated）的 CD8 對 CD4 流式圖：左下角有一大團 CD4-/CD8- 的事件（主要為 CLL 的 B 細胞），僅有少量 CD4+ 與 CD8+ T 細胞兩群；此圖的重點是 T 細胞相對很少，並非 T 細胞異常。
features: Ungated dot plot of CD8-ECD (x-axis) versus CD4-APC750 (y-axis)
Dominant CD4-negative/CD8-negative population in the lower left, representing non-T cells (largely the B-cell clone)
Discrete CD4-positive/CD8-negative helper T-cell cluster (CD4 ~2-3 x 10^4)
Smaller CD8-positive/CD4-negative cytotoxic T-cell cluster (CD8 ~10^5)
Diagonal smear of dim CD4 events consistent with monocytes and debris; no aberrant CD4/CD8 double-positive cluster
62512.describe_en: Ungated flow cytometric plot of CD8 versus CD4 shows that most events are CD4-negative and CD8-negative. Two small, discrete T-cell populations are present, with CD4-positive cells exceeding CD8-positive cells, and a band of dim CD4 events consistent with monocytes. There is no aberrant double-positive or double-negative T-cell cluster. The findings indicate residual normal T-cell subsets that are relatively reduced in proportion, as expected when a B-cell clone such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia dominates the sample.

ddx.vs: T-PLL shows an expanded CD4-positive (or CD4/CD8 double-positive) T-cell population that dominates the plot rather than small normal T-cell clusters.
Sezary syndrome shows an expanded CD4-positive population with a high CD4:CD8 ratio and loss of CD7/CD26.
Reactive samples contain proportionally more T cells, often with CD8 expansion, and lack a dominant monotypic B-cell population.

62448.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆成熟嗜中性球大小的細胞，核分葉不足（僅不規則的單一/雙葉狀）、染色質粗大團塊，細胞質淡藍且幾乎沒有顆粒——即去顆粒化合併假性 Pelger-Huët 樣核（pseudo-Pelger-Huët）的發育不良嗜中性球。
features: Single mature-sized granulocyte, roughly 1.5-2x the diameter of adjacent red cells
Hypolobated nucleus with irregular, non-segmented (pseudo-Pelger-like) contour
Coarse, heavily clumped chromatin inappropriate for the degree of lobation
Markedly hypogranular, pale grey-blue cytoplasm with only a few scattered granules
Background red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with an occasional crenated cell
62448.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single neutrophil with prominent dysplastic features. The nucleus is hypolobated with an irregular, non-segmented contour and coarsely clumped, condensed chromatin, and the cytoplasm is markedly hypogranular. Surrounding red cells are largely unremarkable; no blasts are present in this field. Findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis (pseudo-Pelger-Huët change with hypogranularity), as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms and AML with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Inherited Pelger-Huët cells are normally granulated and involve nearly all neutrophils uniformly, whereas this cell combines hypolobation with marked hypogranularity.
Immature granulocytes have less condensed chromatin and retain secondary granules, rather than showing mature clumped chromatin with an agranular cytoplasm.
Monocytes have lacy, less clumped chromatin, a folded or reniform nucleus, and grey cytoplasm with fine azurophilic dust and often vacuoles.
Morphology may be identical, so clinical drug history and resolution after withdrawal distinguish it from a clonal myeloid neoplasm.

62384.recognize_zh: 中高倍下左半部是成片細胞質鮮紅、雙葉核的嗜酸性球，右半部則是小淋巴球、較大活化淋巴細胞與組織球混合的多形性背景；淋巴結內大量嗜酸性球浸潤可見於 IgG4 相關病變、寄生蟲或過敏反應，需排除何杰金氏淋巴瘤與朗格漢斯組織球增生症。
features: Sheets of eosinophils with bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and bilobed nuclei
Adjacent polymorphous population of small lymphocytes and larger activated lymphoid cells
Scattered histiocytes and small vessels in the polymorphous area
No Reed-Sternberg-like cells or grooved Langerhans cells evident in this field
No eosinophilic abscess with central necrosis seen
62384.describe_en: Sections show a lymph node with a dense infiltrate of eosinophils forming sheets in one area, merging with a polymorphous population of small lymphocytes, larger activated lymphoid cells and histiocytes. Eosinophilic microabscesses with necrosis are not seen in this field. Reed-Sternberg-like cells and Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei are not identified. The findings represent a reactive lymphadenopathy with marked tissue eosinophilia, which can be seen in IgG4-related lymphadenopathy, parasitic or drug reactions, and Kimura disease; exclusion of classic Hodgkin lymphoma and Langerhans cell histiocytosis is recommended.

ddx.vs: CHL contains scattered large CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells within the eosinophil-rich background.
LCH shows sinusoidal clusters of cells with grooved nuclei that are CD1a/langerin-positive, often with eosinophilic abscesses.
Kimura disease features florid follicular hyperplasia with eosinophilic microabscesses, polykaryocytes and markedly elevated serum IgE.
AITL shows expanded paracortex with clear-cell atypical T cells, arborizing HEVs and expanded CD21+ dendritic meshworks.

62320.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血抹片中許多紅血球中央淡染區呈細長裂縫或嘴形（口形紅血球），左下角有一顆小淋巴球可作大小對照，口形紅血球分布於整個視野，符合口形紅血球增多症。
features: Many red cells with elongated slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (stomatocytes)
Stomatocytes are normocytic to slightly macrocytic compared with the small lymphocyte at lower left
Mild anisocytosis; some cells show bowl-like cupped appearance
A few small refractile granules overlying red cells likely represent platelets or debris
Small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin at lower left
62320.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows numerous erythrocytes with a linear, slit-like or mouth-shaped zone of central pallor, consistent with stomatocytes, distributed across the field. The red cells show mild anisocytosis, and a few overlying small granules likely represent platelets. A small mature lymphocyte is present at the lower left. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis, which may be hereditary (overhydrated or dehydrated forms) or acquired, as in alcohol use or liver disease; artifact should be excluded on a fresh smear.

ddx.vs: Artifactual stomatocytes are confined to thick areas of the smear and are absent on a freshly prepared, rapidly dried smear.
Spherocytes lack any central pallor and appear small and dense, unlike the slit pallor here.
Rh-null shows stomatocytes and spherocytes with absent Rh antigens on red cell typing, which cannot be distinguished from other stomatocytosis on morphology alone.

62192.recognize_zh: 冷凍新鮮血漿袋內的血漿呈明顯黃綠色，無乳白混濁或紅色溶血色調；女性捐血者服用口服避孕藥使血清銅藍蛋白（ceruloplasmin）升高，是綠色血漿的常見良性原因。
features: Gross photograph of a frozen fresh frozen plasma unit in its bag
Plasma shows intense yellow-green discoloration
No milky turbidity (lipemia) or red/pink tint (hemolysis) evident
Frost and ice crystal pattern on the frozen bag surface
No macroscopic clots or particulate matter identifiable through the frozen bag
62192.describe_en: Gross photograph of a frozen fresh frozen plasma unit shows intense yellow-green discoloration of the plasma. There is no milky turbidity to suggest lipemia and no red tint to suggest hemolysis, and no particulate material is evident through the frozen bag. Culture of the unit was reported sterile, and the donor reported oral contraceptive use. Findings are consistent with green plasma due to estrogen-induced elevation of ceruloplasmin, a benign donor-related cause; transfusion suitability is governed by institutional policy.

ddx.vs: Contaminated units may show green discoloration with clots, gas or turbidity, and are identified by Gram stain and culture, which was sterile here.
Icteric plasma is deep yellow to brown-orange rather than green and is confirmed by elevated donor bilirubin.

ddx.dx: Drug-related green plasma (methylene blue, propofol, indocyanine green)
ddx.vs: These require a history of the specific drug exposure, whereas this donor reported only oral contraceptive use.
Lipemic plasma is opaque and milky white due to chylomicrons rather than transparent green.

62128.recognize_zh: 中低倍視野中央有一個生發中心，邊界不清且被淡染組織球與粉紅色物質侵入打散，套區不完整，周圍有增生的小血管，即濾泡溶解（folliculolysis），見於 Kimura 病。
features: Enlarged reactive follicle with a germinal center showing irregular, moth-eaten borders
Pale histiocytes and pink eosinophilic material infiltrating and disrupting the germinal center
Attenuated and incomplete mantle zone
Increased small vessels with plump endothelium in the surrounding interfollicular areas
Dense background of small lymphocytes; individual eosinophils not resolved at this power
62128.describe_en: Lymph node section at low to intermediate power shows a reactive follicle with an enlarged germinal center whose borders are irregular and disrupted. The germinal center is infiltrated by pale histiocytes and eosinophilic material, and the mantle zone is attenuated. The interfollicular areas contain increased small vessels with plump endothelial cells among small lymphocytes; eosinophils cannot be reliably resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with folliculolysis, supporting Kimura disease in conjunction with eosinophilia and eosinophilic microabscesses.

ddx.vs: HIV lymphadenitis shows explosive follicular hyperplasia with folliculolysis but without eosinophilic microabscesses or IgE deposits.
PTGC nodules are large and filled with small mantle lymphocytes infiltrating the germinal center rather than histiocytes and eosinophilic material.
Follicular lymphoma has crowded uniform follicles with attenuated mantles and BCL2-positive germinal centers, lacking a disrupted reactive appearance.
AITL shows regressed follicles with expanded FDC meshworks, arborizing HEVs and atypical clear T cells positive for PD1/CXCL13.

62064.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見大量具偏心核與車輪狀染色質的漿細胞，夾雜淡染的組織球與淋巴球，中間有粉紅色均質的膠原纖維帶（sclerosis），漿細胞增生合併纖維化是梅毒性淋巴結炎的典型組合。
features: Dense infiltrate of mature plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped clock-face chromatin and amphophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes and histiocytes/epithelioid cells with pale vesicular oval nuclei and ample pale cytoplasm
Bands of eosinophilic hyalinized collagen traversing the infiltrate (sclerosis)
Occasional plump endothelial-like or spindle cells; no sheets of atypical large cells
No discrete granuloma, necrosis, or neutrophilic abscess in this field
62064.describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows a dense polymorphous infiltrate dominated by mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and coarse clock-face chromatin, admixed with small lymphocytes and histiocytes with vesicular nuclei. Bands of hyalinized eosinophilic collagen traverse the infiltrate, indicating sclerosis. No sheets of atypical large cells, necrosis, or well-formed granulomas are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell-rich reactive lymphadenitis with fibrosis, suggestive of syphilitic lymphadenitis in the appropriate context; Treponema immunostain and serology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytoma shows monotonous sheets of plasma cells with light-chain restriction by kappa/lambda ISH, whereas this infiltrate is polymorphous with histiocytes and fibrosis and is polytypic.

ddx.dx: Castleman disease, plasma cell type (including HHV-8/iMCD)
ddx.vs: Castleman disease shows interfollicular sheets of plasma cells with regressed or hyperplastic follicles and vascular proliferation, and HHV-8 LANA staining in multicentric cases, without spirochetes.
IgG4-related disease shows increased IgG4+ plasma cells (>100/HPF, IgG4/IgG >40%) with storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis, and Treponema stain is negative.
RA lymphadenopathy shows follicular hyperplasia with interfollicular plasmacytosis but lacks capsular fibrosis, vasculitis, and spirochetes, requiring clinical and serologic correlation.

62000.recognize_zh: 大多數圓形單核細胞的細胞核呈中到強棕色染色，其間夾雜少數藍色未染色的背景細胞；以骨髓瘤而言，這種瀰漫性核染色符合 cyclin D1 過度表現，是 t(11;14) 的免疫表型替代指標。
features: Diffuse brown staining in the large majority of round mononuclear cells
Predominantly nuclear staining with variable intensity; some cells also show cytoplasmic blush
Cells are medium-sized with round nuclei, consistent with a plasma cell population
Scattered unstained (hematoxylin-blue) background cells serve as internal negatives
Discohesive cells in a loosely packed section; no architecture assessable
Stain is not labeled; pattern fits cyclin D1 IHC per the case title
62000.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (presumed cyclin D1, not labeled on the image) on a marrow section shows a diffuse population of round mononuclear cells with moderate to strong nuclear staining in the large majority of cells, with some cytoplasmic blush. Scattered unstained background cells are present as internal negatives. In the context of a plasma cell neoplasm, diffuse nuclear cyclin D1 expression is a surrogate for CCND1 rearrangement. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with cyclin D1 expression, suggestive of t(11;14); confirmation by FISH is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are CD20+/CD5+/SOX11+ small lymphocytes lacking CD138 and cytoplasmic light-chain restriction, whereas myeloma cells are CD138+ with monotypic cytoplasmic light chains.
Hairy cell leukemia shows weak cyclin D1 in CD20+/CD103+/annexin A1+/BRAF V600E+ B cells with 'fried-egg' spacing, not CD138+ plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Myeloma with CCND1 overexpression without t(11;14) (e.g., trisomy 11)
ddx.vs: IHC cannot separate these; FISH for t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH defines the translocation.

61936.recognize_zh: A 圖血片中黑色箭頭為核不規則、細胞質含顆粒的大型顆粒淋巴球（LGL），綠色箭頭為中型芽細胞，染色質細緻、可見核仁、無 Auer 小體，背景紅血球多呈棘狀（crenated）；B 圖骨髓抹片中有多個芽細胞（綠色箭頭）與小型異型淋巴球（黑色箭頭）；同時存在兩群異常細胞是本例 AML 合併 LGL 白血病的線索。
features: A (blood): large granular lymphocyte with irregular, condensed nucleus and moderate cytoplasm (black arrow)
A: medium-sized blast with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, visible nucleolus and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm, no Auer rods (green arrowhead)
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely a preparation artifact
B (marrow aspirate): several large blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm without Auer rods (green arrowheads)
B: smaller lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm (black arrows), plus an erythroid precursor with clumped chromatin
Granules in the lymphoid cells are subtle at this resolution
61936.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (A) shows a circulating medium-sized blast with a high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, a visible nucleolus and no Auer rods, adjacent to a lymphoid cell with an irregular condensed nucleus and moderate cytoplasm consistent with a large granular lymphocyte; red cells show prominent crenation, likely artifactual. Bone marrow aspirate (B) shows multiple blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm without Auer rods, together with smaller atypical lymphoid cells and erythroid precursors. The coexistence of blasts and a distinct population of atypical lymphocytes indicates two separate abnormal populations. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with a concomitant large granular lymphocyte proliferation, which in this case was confirmed by flow cytometry as a clonal CD8+/CD57+ T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGL expansions are polyclonal by TCR V-beta or TRG studies and usually transient, whereas LGL leukemia shows a persistent clonal CD8+/CD57+ population often with STAT3 mutation.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia with maturation of blasts into monocytes
ddx.vs: Monocytic cells have folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and are CD14/CD64-positive, unlike the CD3+/CD8+ LGL population.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells are CD3-negative, CD56-positive and EBV-positive with a fulminant course, whereas this LGL population is surface CD3-positive and TCR-restricted.

61808.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖（非形態圖）：在 blast gate 中，CD34 表現由陰性到中等陽性呈連續分布，CD123 多為弱陽性至陰性，未見 CD123 強陽性族群。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on blasts: CD34-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD123-APC (y-axis)
CD34 expression heterogeneous, forming a continuum from negative to moderate
CD123 largely dim to negative across the population
No discrete CD123-bright population identified within the gate
61808.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the gated blast population shows heterogeneous CD34 expression, with a CD34-negative subset merging into a CD34-dim-to-moderate subset, and uniformly dim-to-negative CD123. A discrete CD123-bright population is not present within this gate. Partial CD34 expression on blasts is common in myeloid neoplasms, and the absence of a CD123-bright population argues against blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; note that GATA2 deficiency is characteristically associated with loss of plasmacytoid dendritic cells, which should be assessed on the ungated plot.

61744.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 中央為一條充滿紅血球的血管，管壁及周圍被淋巴細胞浸潤成袖套狀，周圍大片為粉紅色壞死組織；血管中心性（angiocentric）浸潤合併壞死是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的典型架構。
features: Blood vessel with lumen filled by red blood cells
Dense lymphoid infiltrate cuffing and infiltrating the vessel wall (angiocentric pattern)
Extensive surrounding eosinophilic necrosis with scattered ghost cells
Scattered lymphoid cells in the necrotic background
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification
61744.describe_en: Low-power sections show a medium-sized vessel whose wall is infiltrated and cuffed by a lymphoid infiltrate, surrounded by broad areas of eosinophilic necrosis containing scattered cells. Cytologic atypia cannot be graded at this magnification, and no granulomas or neutrophilic microabscesses are evident in this field. The angiocentric lymphoid infiltrate with necrosis is consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, to be confirmed with CD20 and EBER staining.

ddx.vs: GPA has geographic basophilic necrosis with palisading histiocytes, giant cells and neutrophils, and lacks EBER-positive atypical B cells.
ENKTL shares angiocentric necrosis but the atypical cells are CD56/cytoplasmic CD3-positive NK/T cells.
Infectious necrosis shows well-formed granulomas and organisms on special stains (AFB, GMS) rather than an atypical lymphoid vascular infiltrate.

61680.recognize_zh: 這顆中等大小的淋巴樣細胞核圓、染色質中度濃縮，核中央可見淡色核仁，最明顯的是深嗜鹼性細胞質邊緣長出的大型泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），這是 T-PLL 細胞的教科書特徵。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell, slightly larger than adjacent red cells
High N:C ratio with a round nucleus
Moderately condensed chromatin with a visible pale central nucleolus
Scant, deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Prominent cytoplasmic blebs, including a large rounded protrusion at the upper right and a smaller one at the left
Background normocytic red cells
61680.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized atypical lymphoid cell with a high N:C ratio. The nucleus is round with moderately condensed chromatin and a visible central nucleolus. The scant cytoplasm is deeply basophilic, agranular and forms prominent rounded surface blebs. Findings are consistent with a prolymphocyte of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, to be confirmed by immunophenotyping and TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement studies.

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a very prominent single nucleolus, more abundant pale cytoplasm and lack cytoplasmic blebs, and are CD19/CD20 positive.
Hairy cells show fine, circumferential hair-like projections with pale gray-blue cytoplasm and no nucleolus rather than discrete basophilic blebs.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and scant pale cytoplasm without blebs, and are usually CD7 and CD26 negative.

ddx.dx: Smear-related cytoplasmic budding in reactive lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Artifactual budding occurs in scattered heterogeneous reactive lymphocytes, whereas blebs in T-PLL are seen consistently across a monotonous population with nucleolated nuclei.

61616.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑旁大片中大型細胞，核卵圓、染色質細緻並有小核仁，胞質淡染，正常造血成分明顯減少，符合 AML 的芽細胞片狀浸潤。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large immature cells with oval, occasionally indented nuclei
Fine, open chromatin with small but visible nucleoli
Moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders
Scattered residual erythroid precursors, eosinophils, and segmented neutrophils
Paratrabecular and interstitial involvement with focal hemosiderin-laden macrophages
61616.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a hypercellular marrow in which the paratrabecular and interstitial spaces are replaced by sheets of medium-to-large immature cells with oval nuclei, fine open chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm. Residual hematopoiesis is reduced to scattered erythroid precursors, eosinophils, and neutrophils. Scattered hemosiderin pigment is noted. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the CEBPA-mutated subtype requires molecular confirmation.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts are smaller with scant cytoplasm; distinction requires MPO and lymphoid IHC/flow (TdT, CD19, CD3).

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, are CD20/PAX5-positive, and often form paratrabecular aggregates with fibrosis.
MDS-EB has <20% blasts with preserved dysplastic hematopoiesis rather than confluent sheets of blasts.

61552.recognize_zh: FDG-PET 最大強度投影（MIP）影像中，上縱膈可見多發融合的高攝取結節團塊，並伴隨多個椎體、骨盆與股骨的局灶性攝取（提示骨髓侵犯）；腎臟、輸尿管與膀胱的濃聚為生理性排泄。
features: Coronal FDG-PET maximum intensity projection image
Conglomerate multinodular FDG-avid mass in the upper mediastinum/anterior chest
Multifocal FDG uptake in several vertebral bodies, pelvic bones and proximal femur, suggesting skeletal/marrow involvement
Physiologic excretory activity in kidneys, ureters and urinary bladder; brain activity at top edge
Low-resolution image; exact nodal stations and SUV values not assessable
61552.describe_en: Coronal FDG-PET maximum intensity projection image shows a bulky, conglomerate multinodular hypermetabolic mass in the mediastinum. Multiple discrete foci of increased uptake are seen in vertebral bodies, the pelvis and a proximal femur, consistent with multifocal osseous/marrow involvement rather than the diffuse homogeneous uptake of reactive marrow. Intense activity in the renal collecting systems, ureters and bladder is physiologic. In a patient with classic Hodgkin lymphoma these findings indicate mediastinal disease with focal skeletal/marrow lesions (advanced stage); resolution precludes precise nodal mapping or SUV assessment.

ddx.vs: PMBL also forms a bulky FDG-avid anterior mediastinal mass, so biopsy (CD20+, CD23+, MAL+ sheets versus scattered CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells) is needed to separate them.

ddx.dx: Diffuse reactive marrow uptake (G-CSF, anemia, inflammation)
ddx.vs: Reactive marrow shows diffuse homogeneous skeletal uptake rather than the discrete multifocal lesions seen here.

ddx.dx: Thymic epithelial tumor or germ cell tumor
ddx.vs: These produce an anterior mediastinal mass but are usually solitary without multifocal skeletal lesions, and require biopsy for diagnosis.

61488.recognize_zh: 中倍視野下骨髓細胞密度高，脂肪空泡之間可見多顆大型巨核細胞（部分兩三顆靠近），核分葉、細胞質豐富且無明顯異型，背景為成熟中的紅血球與顆粒球系，符合 ITP 的巨核細胞增加。
features: Cellular marrow fragment with interspersed round fat spaces
Increased megakaryocytes, mostly single with occasional adjacent pairs, not forming dense clusters
Megakaryocytes large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with prominent erythroid precursors and granulocytes
No fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate in this field
61488.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a cellular fragment with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed adipocytes. Megakaryocytes are increased, mostly dispersed singly with an occasional adjacent pair, and are large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei without significant atypia. No fibrosis, granulomas or neoplastic infiltrate is seen in this field. In a patient with isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are giant and hyperlobated in loose clusters with thrombocytosis, while ITP megakaryocytes are normal-appearing with a low platelet count.
PMF shows dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and granulocytic proliferation, not the unremarkable megakaryocytes here.
Marrow may be similar; splenomegaly and involvement of other cell lines point to sequestration rather than immune destruction.

61424.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨噬細胞邊緣與周圍聚集許多小型卵圓形紫色小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），大小均一，旁邊為顆粒球前驅細胞，符合利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體。
features: Macrophage with pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing a cluster of small uniform oval purple organisms at its lower edge
Organisms about 2-4 um, several showing a darker dot suggestive of a kinetoplast (limited resolution)
Adjacent promyelocytes/myelocytes with azurophilic granules for size comparison
Background of maturing granulocytes, erythroblasts and lymphocytes
61424.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors with azurophilic granules, erythroblasts and lymphocytes. A macrophage with pale cytoplasm contains a cluster of numerous small, uniform, oval organisms, some with a suggestion of an eccentric dot-like kinetoplast. No other abnormal cell population is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies).

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts lack a kinetoplast and show a pericellular clear halo and GMS positivity.
Promyelocyte granules are smaller, irregular, overlie the nucleus and are confined to the granulocyte cytoplasm rather than being discrete oval organisms.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central septum and lack a kinetoplast.

61360.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央幾顆巨核細胞的細胞質豐富、淡粉紅色，但細胞核分成數個彼此分離、小而圓的核葉（widely separated lobes），另可見只有單一小核的巨核細胞，這種核葉分離與低分葉的型態是骨髓化生不良症候群的巨核細胞發育不良。
features: Megakaryocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small, round, widely separated nuclear lobes
Megakaryocyte with a single small round nucleus (hypolobated form)
Nuclei of megakaryocytes with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Hypercellular intertrabecular marrow with erythroid and myeloid precursors between fat spaces
Scattered eosinophilic precursors and extravasated red cells
61360.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces. Several megakaryocytes are dysplastic, with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small round nuclear lobes that are widely separated from one another, and one form has a single small round nucleus.
