Megakaryocyte clustering or marked atypia of other lineages cannot be fully assessed in this single field. Findings are consistent with dysmegakaryopoiesis, as seen in myelodysplastic syndromes, and should be correlated with aspirate morphology, blast count and cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic changes (HIV, alcohol, drug effect)
ddx.vs: Occasional separated lobes may occur, but dysplasia is limited and resolves when the cause is removed, without clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Characteristically shows small monolobated or bilobed megakaryocytes predominating, with macrocytic anemia and preserved or increased platelets.
Megakaryocytes form tight clusters with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and associated reticulin fibrosis rather than separated round lobes.
Megakaryocytes may be hyperlobated with separated lobes, but erythroid and myeloid megaloblastic change and low B12/folate levels are present.

61296.recognize_zh: 大型組織球的細胞質豐富且帶空泡，內含被吞噬的嗜中性球、帶橘黃色的紅血球及核碎片，細胞質明確包圍這些細胞；在淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的背景下代表巨噬細胞活化與噬血現象。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale blue, vacuolated cytoplasm and round nuclei with fine chromatin
Engulfed segmented neutrophil and band within the cytoplasm
Ingested red cells and orange-brown red cell remnants within phagocytic vacuoles
Nuclear debris and a pyknotic cell fragment within cytoplasm
Adjacent smudged cells; background red cells and scattered platelets
61296.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large activated histiocytes with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm. The histiocytes contain engulfed neutrophils, erythrocytes and red cell remnants, and nuclear debris within clear phagocytic vacuoles. Adjacent smudged cells are present, and the background shows scattered red cells and platelets. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in this patient with EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the marrow, correlation with HLH diagnostic criteria is recommended.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris only, without intact ingested erythrocytes or neutrophils.
Overlying cells lie in a different focal plane without a surrounding phagocytic vacuole.

ddx.dx: Tumor cells with emperipolesis or cannibalism
ddx.vs: Tumor cells engulfing other cells have malignant nuclear features, whereas these phagocytes have bland histiocytic nuclei.

61232.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見許多大型組織球，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、核圓而空泡狀並有小核仁，胞質內包著完整的淋巴球與漿細胞（emperipolesis），周圍大量漿細胞，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and ill-defined borders
Round vesicular histiocyte nuclei with small distinct nucleoli
Intact small lymphocytes and plasma cells within histiocyte cytoplasm, often surrounded by a clear halo (emperipolesis)
Dense background of mature plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei and small lymphocytes
Scattered clear spaces/cleft artifact; no significant nuclear atypia or mitotic activity
61232.describe_en: High-power H&E section of lymph node shows sheets and clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli. Many histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within their cytoplasm, frequently within clear halos, indicating emperipolesis. The background is rich in mature plasma cells and small lymphocytes, without atypical large cells or Reed-Sternberg-like forms. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease; S100 positivity with CD1a negativity in the histiocytes supports the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cells are smaller with grooved coffee-bean nuclei, accompanied by eosinophils, lack emperipolesis and are CD1a/langerin positive.
Histiocytes are smaller, lack prominent emperipolesis and are S100 negative.
Histiocytes phagocytose red cells, nuclear debris and platelets that are degraded, rather than harboring intact viable lymphocytes, and S100 is negative.
Shows plasma cell-rich infiltrate but lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis and has increased IgG4+ plasma cells.

61168.recognize_zh: A 格 H&E 中在混合發炎背景裡有多核、核仁大而明顯的 Reed-Sternberg 樣大細胞；B 格大細胞呈膜狀與高基氏體（Golgi）點狀染色，D 格原位雜交大細胞核呈深藍陽性，E、G 格則顯示背景的 CLL 小淋巴球族群，符合 CLL 發生 Hodgkin 型 Richter 轉化。
features: Panel A (H&E): large multinucleated Reed-Sternberg-like cell with prominent inclusion-like nucleoli in a mixed background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes
Panel B (IHC): large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot (Golgi) staining pattern, typical of CD30/CD15 in Hodgkin cells
Panel C (double IHC): scattered large cells with weak brown nuclear staining amid red-labeled small background cells
Panel D (ISH): dark blue nuclear signal in large cells, consistent with EBER positivity
Panel E: dense sheet of small cells with red membranous staining representing the CLL/background lymphoid population, with interspersed brown nuclei
Panels F and G: large cells with nuclear staining (F) and flow cytometry plots showing a clonal B-cell population (G); exact antigens not labeled in the figure
61168.describe_en: This composite shows a lymphoid infiltrate containing scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells with multilobated nuclei and prominent inclusion-like nucleoli in a mixed background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes. Immunohistochemistry shows the large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot-like staining typical of CD30/CD15, weak nuclear staining in a double-stained panel, and nuclear positivity for EBV-encoded RNA by in situ hybridization. Other panels show a dense population of small lymphocytes corresponding to the underlying chronic lymphocytic leukemia and flow cytometry demonstrating a clonal B-cell population. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma arising in CLL (Hodgkin-variant Richter transformation); antigen identities should be confirmed against the original legend.

ddx.vs: HRS-like cells scattered within a background of CLL cells, without a true mixed inflammatory Hodgkin background, are recognized separately and do not constitute full cHL.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / DLBCL-type Richter transformation
ddx.vs: DLBCL forms confluent sheets of large cells with strong CD20/CD45 expression, lacking the CD15/CD30 Golgi pattern and weak PAX5 of HRS cells.
ALCL shows cohesive sheets of hallmark cells that are CD30 positive but PAX5 negative, often with T-cell markers or ALK.
Large cells in THRLBCL are CD20 and OCT2/BOB1 strongly positive and CD15/CD30 negative.

61168.stain: H&E, IHC (double stain), ISH: EBER, flow cytometry

61104.recognize_zh: 周邊血的單核球／吞噬細胞內可見細小的點狀體，骨髓抹片的巨噬細胞內與周圍更有大量小型卵圓形生物體，具紫色核（部分可見小的桿狀 kinetoplast），即 Leishman-Donovan 小體；骨髓切片則見組織球增生與漿細胞，符合內臟利什曼原蟲病。
features: PB (A): prominent red cell clumping/rouleaux-like aggregates with a small lymphocyte and scattered platelets
PB (B): monocyte/phagocyte with a few small dot-like intracytoplasmic bodies consistent with amastigotes
BM aspirate (C): macrophages packed with numerous small oval amastigotes, each with a purple nucleus and a tiny rod-shaped kinetoplast where resolvable, plus extracellular organisms
BM biopsy (D): increased histiocytes with granular/foamy cytoplasm, plasma cells and small lymphocytes
Image resolution limits reliable visualization of the kinetoplast in PB
61104.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear shows red cell clumping in a rouleaux-like pattern, and a circulating phagocyte contains small dot-like intracytoplasmic bodies. The bone marrow aspirate shows macrophages distended by numerous small oval amastigotes with a nucleus and, where resolvable, a rod-shaped kinetoplast, with additional organisms released extracellularly. The core biopsy shows increased histiocytes with granular cytoplasm and a background of plasma cells and lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis involving peripheral blood and bone marrow; confirmation by culture, PCR or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo, a crescent-shaped nucleus and no kinetoplast, and are GMS/PAS positive.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without a kinetoplast and seldom seen packed within marrow macrophages.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Platelets lie on top of the cell with granular purple centers and pale periphery, lacking a defined nucleus-kinetoplast arrangement.

61040.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被多形性浸潤取代，許多中型細胞胞質透明（clear cells），其間穿插大量分枝狀的細長血管（arborizing high endothelial venules），這種血管增生加上透明細胞是血管免疫母細胞 T 細胞淋巴瘤（AITL）的線索。
features: Effaced lymph node architecture without residual follicles in this field
Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes and medium-sized cells with clear cytoplasm
Prominent arborizing, slender branching vessels (high endothelial venules) throughout
Scattered eosinophilic cells/histiocytes and interstitial pink material
No sheets of large cells or granulomas at this magnification
61040.describe_en: Section of lymph node at medium power shows diffuse effacement by a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes admixed with numerous medium-sized cells with clear cytoplasm. There is prominent proliferation of arborizing high endothelial venules traversing the infiltrate, with scattered histiocytes and eosinophilic cells. No residual reactive follicles are seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma (nodal TFH-cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type); confirmation requires TFH markers (PD-1, CD10, BCL6, CXCL13), CD21 for expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks, and T-cell clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia preserves sinuses and follicles, lacks clusters of clear atypical cells, and shows no aberrant TFH phenotype or clonal TCR.
PTCL-NOS lacks the prominent arborizing HEVs, expanded FDC meshworks and consistent TFH marker expression.
cHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background without clear-cell T-cell clusters.

60976.recognize_zh: 下方細胞為核偏心、有核周淡染區、細胞質深藍的漿細胞，細胞質內可見數條細長、紫紅色的棒狀包涵體（類 Auer 小體）與一顆小圓點；漿細胞中出現這種嗜天青棒狀結晶，提示骨髓瘤細胞內免疫球蛋白結晶化。
features: Lower cell: plasma cell with eccentric round nucleus, clumped chromatin and deep basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear pallor
Several slender, needle-like azurophilic (pink-purple) rod-shaped intracytoplasmic inclusions overlying the perinuclear region, plus a small dot-like inclusion
Upper cell: round nucleus with abundant lilac cytoplasm containing fine granules; lineage uncertain in this single field (possibly an immature granulocyte or plasma cell with fine granulation)
Clean smear background with scattered red cells and platelet/stain debris; no other cells for context
60976.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grunwald-Giemsa) shows a plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing several slender, rod-shaped azurophilic inclusions resembling Auer rods, together with a small round inclusion. An adjacent cell with a round nucleus and finely granular lilac cytoplasm is present, and its lineage cannot be established from this single field. Auer rod-like crystalline inclusions in plasma cells represent crystallized immunoglobulin (often kappa light chain) and, in the clinical context of IgG kappa myeloma, the findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with Auer rod-like inclusions.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods
ddx.vs: True Auer rods occur in MPO-positive myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas these rods lie in mature-appearing plasma cells with clumped chromatin and are MPO-negative.
Crystals accumulate in histiocytes (CD68/CD163-positive, abundant pale cytoplasm), not in basophilic plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies / Dutcher bodies
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are round globules and Dutcher bodies are intranuclear pseudoinclusions, not slender needle-shaped crystals.

ddx.dx: Acquired Fanconi syndrome-associated light-chain crystal myeloma
ddx.vs: Also has crystalline kappa inclusions; distinguished by proximal tubulopathy and needle crystals in renal tubular cells rather than by marrow morphology.

60912.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑之間幾乎全被大量粉紅細胞質的巨核細胞群佔據，左側可見細胞核呈流線狀排列（纖維化），脂肪與正常造血幾乎消失，於唐氏症兒童符合 ML-DS。
features: Hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement of intertrabecular spaces
Tremendous megakaryocytic hyperplasia with numerous megakaryocytes of variable size and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Streaming, spindled nuclei in the left fragment consistent with marrow fibrosis
Absence of marrow fat; residual normal hematopoiesis inconspicuous
Bony trabeculae without obvious osteosclerosis
60912.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with loss of fat. The intertrabecular spaces are replaced by a dense proliferation of megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and variably sized nuclei, admixed with smaller immature cells. In the left portion of the biopsy the nuclei are spindled and streaming, suggestive of reticulin fibrosis. In a child with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome; reticulin stain and CD61/CD42b immunostains are recommended.

ddx.vs: PMF occurs in older adults with bizarre hyperchromatic cloud-like megakaryocytes and osteosclerosis, not sheets of megakaryoblasts in a Down syndrome child.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor with fibrosis
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive nests and lack platelet glycoprotein expression, while here the proliferation is megakaryocytic.
TAM occurs in neonates (usually <3 months) and resolves spontaneously, whereas ML-DS arises later (typically <5 years) often after a myelodysplastic phase with marrow fibrosis.

60848.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中兩個晚期紅系前驅細胞的核分裂成多個大小不一的核葉/核碎（nuclear budding、multilobation），旁邊的早期紅母細胞核大、染色質開放呈巨母細胞樣（megaloblastoid），且無異常前骨髓細胞；結合 APL 經砷劑與 ATRA 治療的病史，屬藥物引起的紅系發育異常。
features: Two late erythroid precursors with orthochromatic/polychromatic cytoplasm and abnormally segmented nuclei forming multiple small round lobes (nuclear budding/multinuclearity)
Early erythroid precursors (basophilic normoblasts) with deep blue cytoplasm and enlarged nuclei with open, finely stippled megaloblastoid chromatin
Additional large precursor with fine chromatin and a small nucleolus at lower left
Normally segmented, granulated neutrophil at upper left; no abnormal promyelocytes, Auer rods or faggot cells in this field
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis
60848.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of erythroid precursors with dysplastic features. Two late erythroid precursors display abnormal nuclear segmentation into multiple small round lobes, and adjacent basophilic normoblasts have enlarged nuclei with open, megaloblastoid chromatin, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. A neutrophil in the field is normally segmented and granulated, and no abnormal promyelocytes or Auer rods are identified. In a patient treated with arsenic trioxide and ATRA for acute promyelocytic leukemia, these findings are consistent with therapy-related (arsenic-induced) erythroid dysplasia and should not be interpreted as myelodysplastic neoplasm without supporting evidence.

ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; persistent multilineage dysplasia, clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormalities and persistence after drug withdrawal favor MDS over transient arsenic effect.
Megaloblastic anemia also shows megaloblastoid chromatin and nuclear lobation but has hypersegmented neutrophils and giant metamyelocytes and resolves with vitamin replacement.
Relapse shows abnormal hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles and PML::RARA detection, none of which are present here.
CDA is a lifelong congenital disorder with binucleate/internuclear bridging erythroblasts, not an acquired change following chemotherapy.

60784.recognize_zh: Ki-67 染色在瀰漫浸潤的淋巴瘤細胞中幾乎全數呈棕色核陽性（估計 >90%），只有右側間質內梭形細胞與少數小細胞為陰性，代表極高增生指數，符合母細胞型被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-sized lymphoid cells on the left with nuclear Ki-67 staining in nearly all tumor cells
Estimated proliferation index greater than 90% in the tumor sheet
Right side shows looser stroma with spindle cells and scattered negative cells, plus infiltrating Ki-67-positive tumor cells
Variable staining intensity, including some cells with nucleolar accentuation
60784.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for Ki-67 shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized lymphoid cells with nuclear positivity in more than 90% of tumor cells, extending into adjacent stroma, where spindle stromal cells are negative. This very high proliferation index is an adverse prognostic feature. In a CD20-positive, cyclin D1-positive lymphoma with blastoid cytology, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid variant with a very high proliferation fraction.

ddx.vs: Ki-67 is also near 100%, but cells are CD10+/BCL6+ and BCL2 and cyclin D1 negative with MYC rearrangement.
Usually has a Ki-67 index well under 30% with small cleaved cells, whereas more than 30% defines a high-risk group typical of blastoid/pleomorphic variants.
Has a similarly high proliferation fraction but expresses TdT and lacks cyclin D1.
Also highly proliferative, but lacks cyclin D1/SOX11 and CCND1 rearrangement.

60592.recognize_zh: 超活體染色（supravital stain）下幾乎每個紅血球內都有深藍色沉澱的顆粒或網狀物質，箭頭所指細胞內含粗大團聚的包涵體；大量紅血球含沉澱物提示不穩定血紅素造成的 Heinz 小體與網狀紅血球增多，但本圖解析度下難以完全區分兩者。
features: Supravital-stained smear with nearly all red cells containing dark blue precipitated inclusions
Inclusions vary from fine reticular/filamentous material to coarse clumped granules (arrow)
Some inclusions are coarse and irregular rather than the evenly distributed fine 'golf ball' pattern of HbH
Background shows stained platelets and plasma debris; resolution limits separating reticulocyte reticulum from Heinz bodies
60592.describe_en: Supravitally stained peripheral blood smear shows that the large majority of red cells contain dark blue precipitated material, ranging from fine reticular networks to coarse clumped granular inclusions (arrow). The pattern indicates marked reticulocytosis with intraerythrocytic precipitates rather than the uniform golf-ball stippling of hemoglobin H. At this magnification reticulocyte RNA cannot be reliably distinguished from membrane-bound Heinz bodies, which should be confirmed with crystal violet staining, heat/isopropanol stability testing and globin gene sequencing. Findings are suggestive of hereditary hemolytic anemia due to an unstable hemoglobin.

ddx.vs: HbH inclusions are numerous, fine and evenly distributed ('golf ball') after incubation with brilliant cresyl blue, rather than coarse eccentric clumps.
Heinz bodies occur episodically after oxidant exposure with bite/blister cells and a low G6PD activity, while unstable hemoglobin gives chronic hemolysis and positive heat stability test.
Reticulocytes show fine reticular RNA networks only and the smear shows spherocytes with positive EMA binding, without Heinz body precipitates.
Features coarse basophilic stippling on Wright stain rather than supravital Heinz bodies, confirmed by enzyme assay.

60656.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞吞噬有核細胞（黑箭頭，嗜血現象），旁邊有胞質深藍、含空泡的大型不典型淋巴瘤細胞（紅箭頭）；B 圖切片為成片的大型多形性細胞，C 圖 IHC 呈強烈膜狀與 Golgi 區陽性（符合 CD30），指向 ALK 陰性 ALCL 侵犯骨髓。
features: Aspirate: large macrophages containing engulfed nucleated cells and red cells (hemophagocytosis, black arrow)
Large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular nuclei (red arrow)
Biopsy H&E: sheets of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, irregular to kidney-shaped nuclei and occasional prominent nucleoli
Possible hallmark-like cell with eccentric reniform nucleus (red arrow, panel B)
IHC (panel C): strong, diffuse membranous and paranuclear dot (Golgi) staining in essentially all large cells, pattern typical of CD30
60656.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (panel A) shows histiocytes with prominent hemophagocytosis of nucleated cells, together with large atypical lymphoid cells having irregular nuclei and deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm. The core biopsy (H&E, panel B) shows a diffuse infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with irregular, occasionally reniform nuclei, replacing normal hematopoiesis. Immunohistochemistry (panel C) shows strong, uniform membranous and Golgi-pattern staining of the neoplastic cells, consistent with CD30 (marker not labeled in the image). In the context of absent ALK expression, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma with associated hemophagocytosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology and CD30 staining are identical; only ALK immunostaining (or ALK rearrangement) separates them.
cHL has scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background with CD15/PAX5 (weak) positivity, not uniform sheets of CD30-positive cells lacking PAX5.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with CD30 expression
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS usually shows heterogeneous, weaker CD30 staining in a subset of cells, rather than strong, uniform CD30 in all cells with hallmark cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with keratin positivity and melanoma expresses S100/SOX10, whereas ALCL is discohesive and CD30/T-cell marker positive.

60720.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿中型母細胞，細胞質灰藍、無顆粒，部分有細胞質突起；切片瀰漫浸潤並呈 TCL1、CD123、CD56 陽性，流式也呈單一族群，符合瀰漫散播型母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤 (BPDCN)。
features: Panel A: sheets of medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, round to irregular nuclei and moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm; insets show clot/biopsy infiltrate and blasts with cytoplasmic projections
Panel B: diffuse strong TCL1 positivity in the marrow infiltrate
Panel C: diffuse CD123 positivity
Panel D: diffuse CD56 positivity
Panels E-F: flow cytometry plots showing a single dominant tight population (axis labels not legible)
60720.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate is replaced by medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and moderate agranular cytoplasm, some with pseudopod-like cytoplasmic projections. The biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate that is strongly positive for TCL1, CD123 and CD56 by immunohistochemistry, and flow cytometry demonstrates a single dominant abnormal population (axis labels are not legible in this figure). Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm with extensive marrow involvement.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML may express CD56 and CD123 but is MPO/lysozyme or CD14/CD11c positive and usually TCL1 and TCF4 negative.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56+ but EBER positive with cytoplasmic CD3ε and cytotoxic granules, and lacks CD123/TCL1.
T-ALL blasts express TdT and cytoplasmic CD3, not the CD4/CD56/CD123/TCL1 combination.

60720.stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC: TCL1, CD123, CD56; flow cytometry

60528.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色（未標示抗體）中，大量小至中型淋巴樣細胞呈清楚的膜狀棕色陽性、瀰漫分布，其間夾雜細胞核淡染卵圓、陰性的類上皮組織球；陽性淋巴細胞佔多數，符合以 T 細胞為主的浸潤型態。
features: IHC with brown DAB chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain; antibody not labeled
Diffuse membranous positivity in numerous small-to-medium lymphoid cells
Positive cells show mildly irregular nuclei outlined by crisp membrane staining
Interspersed negative larger cells with pale oval nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, resembling epithelioid histiocytes
Small negative vascular structures traverse the field; faint background cytoplasmic blush
60528.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows diffuse membranous positivity in a dense population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with mildly irregular nuclei. Interspersed negative cells with pale oval nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, consistent with epithelioid histiocytes, and small negative vessels are also present. The antibody is not labeled, so the specific lineage marker cannot be read from the image, although the membranous pattern in the predominant lymphoid population is typical of a pan-T-cell marker such as CD3 or CD2. In the context of the title, the findings are compatible with the T-cell-predominant infiltrate of lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) lymphoma, a variant of peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, which requires assessment for aberrant antigen loss and TCR clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells retain all pan-T antigens with a normal CD4:CD8 mix and are polyclonal, whereas PTCL often shows antigen loss (e.g., CD7, CD5) and clonal TCR.
AITL neoplastic cells express TFH markers (PD1, ICOS, CXCL13) with expanded CD21+ dendritic meshworks around high endothelial venules.
THRLBCL contains scattered large CD20+ B cells, which would be negative on a T-cell marker and highlighted by CD20.

60464.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片 MUM1 染色，真皮內密集腫瘤細胞幾乎全部呈強烈細胞核棕色陽性，表皮角質細胞為陰性；MUM1 瀰漫陽性是腿型原發皮膚瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤與濾泡中心淋巴瘤區分的重點。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate with strong diffuse nuclear MUM1/IRF4 positivity in nearly all tumor cells
Infiltrate extends up to the dermal-epidermal junction with minimal sparing
Overlying epidermis and hair follicle epithelium negative (internal negative control)
Negative vascular and stromal spaces between sheets of positive cells
Nuclear staining in relatively large nuclei
60464.describe_en: MUM1 (IRF4) immunostain on a skin biopsy shows strong diffuse nuclear positivity in nearly all cells of a dense dermal infiltrate extending up to the dermal-epidermal junction. The epidermis and adnexal epithelium are negative. Diffuse MUM1 expression in a large B-cell infiltrate supports a non-germinal center (activated B-cell) phenotype. Findings are consistent with primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma, diffuse pattern
ddx.vs: PCFCL is usually MUM1 negative, BCL2 negative or weak, and BCL6 positive with a germinal center phenotype.
Morphology and phenotype overlap, so staging studies are required to exclude systemic disease before assigning a primary cutaneous diagnosis.
Both are MUM1 positive but are CD20 negative and CD138 positive with plasmacytic morphology.

60272.recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區可見淡染的組織球／蘭格漢斯細胞（核細長、有核溝、細胞質淡粉紅）與小淋巴球混雜，其中散佈含棕色顆粒狀黑色素（melanin）的巨噬細胞，這種組合就是皮膚病變引流淋巴結的皮膚病性變化（dermatopathic change）。
features: Paracortical expansion by pale histiocytes and interdigitating dendritic/Langerhans-type cells with elongated, folded or grooved nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Scattered macrophages containing coarse brown granular pigment consistent with melanin
Admixed small mature lymphocytes forming a mottled pattern
Prominent high endothelial venules within the paracortex
No atypical lymphoid cells or cerebriform nuclei evident at this magnification
60272.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows paracortical expansion by a mixture of pale-staining histiocytes and dendritic cells with elongated, folded to grooved nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small mature lymphocytes and high endothelial venules. Numerous scattered macrophages contain coarse brown granular pigment consistent with melanin. No cytologically atypical lymphoid population is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with dermatopathic lymphadenopathy, a reactive change in nodes draining chronic skin conditions; in patients with erythroderma, early involvement by mycosis fungoides should be excluded with T-cell markers and clonality studies.

ddx.dx: Lymph node involvement by mycosis fungoides/Sézary syndrome
ddx.vs: MF involvement shows clusters or sheets of atypical cerebriform lymphocytes with loss of T-cell antigens and a clonal TCR rearrangement rather than only benign small lymphocytes.
LCH shows sinusoidal sheets of Langerhans cells with frequent eosinophils and eosinophilic microabscesses, not a mottled paracortical pattern with melanin-laden macrophages.
Melanoma forms cohesive nests of atypical cells with prominent nucleoli and SOX10/HMB45 positivity, while here pigment is within bland macrophages.
Hemosiderin is golden-brown and refractile and stains with Prussian blue, whereas melanin is finer, darker brown and Fontana-Masson positive.

60144.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中母細胞大量取代正常造血，且呈兩種族群：中大型、核仁明顯、細胞質中等偏嗜鹼性的母細胞，與較小、核質比高、核仁不明顯的母細胞混雜，提示混合表型急性白血病（MPAL），需以流式確認。
features: Marked increase in blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis
Dimorphic blast population: intermediate-to-large blasts with prominent nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Second population of smaller blasts with high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm and indistinct nucleoli
Fine, dispersed chromatin in both populations; no Auer rods evident
Residual megakaryocyte and a few maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
60144.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a marked increase in blasts with relatively little residual normal hematopoiesis. The blasts form two morphologic populations: intermediate to large cells with prominent nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, and smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and indistinct nucleoli. Auer rods are not identified in this field. A residual megakaryocyte and occasional maturing myeloid cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with a dimorphic blast population, and in conjunction with flow cytometry are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML may show myeloid-looking blasts, but flow cytometry lacks lineage-defining lymphoid markers (cCD3 or strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10).
ALL lacks MPO and monocytic differentiation markers, and a coexisting large nucleolated myeloid blast population argues against it.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia of ambiguous lineage, undifferentiated
ddx.vs: AUL lacks lineage-specific markers altogether, whereas MPAL meets criteria for two lineages by flow or cytochemistry.

60080.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見一個特別大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核深度分葉呈鹿角狀（staghorn/hyperlobated），周圍還有數個大型巨核細胞散在分布而非緊密成簇，背景造血細胞豐富；大而成熟、分葉過度的巨核細胞是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的特徵。
features: Enlarged megakaryocyte with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply lobulated, hyperlobated ('staghorn') nucleus
Additional large mature megakaryocytes nearby, loosely scattered rather than forming tight clusters
Megakaryocyte nuclei show mature chromatin without bulbous hyperchromatic cloud-like forms
Hypercellular background with normal-appearing maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors
No reticulin fibrosis or blast aggregates apparent on H&E at this power
60080.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and increased megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes include enlarged mature forms with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply lobulated, hyperlobated staghorn-like nuclei; they are loosely dispersed or form only loose groups, without tight clustering or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei. Erythroid and granulocytic maturation appear unremarkable and no increase in blasts is evident. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical context (sustained thrombocytosis, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, grade 0-1 reticulin).

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are atypical with bulbous, hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and high N:C ratio, form dense clusters, and the marrow shows granulocytic proliferation with reduced erythropoiesis.
Shows panmyelosis with prominent erythroid and granulocytic proliferation and pleomorphic megakaryocytes of variable size, together with elevated hemoglobin/red cell mass.
Megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated ('dwarf') in a granulocyte-dominated marrow; BCR::ABL1 testing excludes it.
Megakaryocytes may be increased but lack the giant hyperlobated forms and the marrow is not a clonal MPN; clinical cause (iron deficiency, inflammation) and absent driver mutation support reactive.

60016.recognize_zh: 周邊血中母細胞呈兩種型態：數顆小到中型、細胞質極少、核略凹陷的淋巴母細胞樣細胞，以及一顆較大、有中量藍色細胞質與不規則核的母細胞，旁邊還有一顆成熟嗜中性球；雙型態母細胞提示混合表型急性白血病。
features: Dimorphic circulating blast population
Small to intermediate blasts with scant basophilic cytoplasm, indented or angulated nuclei, fine chromatin, and indistinct nucleoli
Larger blast with moderate pale-basophilic cytoplasm, irregular nuclear contour, fine chromatin, and a faint nucleolus
Residual mature neutrophil with normal granulation
Normocytic red cells with no Auer rods seen; platelets appear reduced
60016.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts with a dimorphic morphology. Several blasts are small to intermediate in size with scant basophilic cytoplasm, indented nuclear contours, fine chromatin, and indistinct nucleoli, while a larger blast shows moderate basophilic cytoplasm, an irregular nuclear outline, and a nucleolus. A mature neutrophil is present, red cells are normocytic, and no Auer rods are identified. These two morphologically distinct blast populations raise concern for mixed phenotype acute leukemia; with flow cytometric demonstration of B and myeloid lineages and t(9;22), the findings are consistent with MPAL with BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Ph-positive B-ALL has blasts of variable size but lacks a separate MPO-positive myeloid blast population by flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid or mixed blast phase
ddx.vs: CML blast phase shows background basophilia and a left-shifted myeloid bulge with a prior chronic-phase history, which are absent in de novo MPAL.
The larger cell may mimic a promonocyte, but AMML lacks the small lymphoblast-like population and B-lineage markers.
CLL cells have coarse clumped chromatin with smudge cells, not the fine blastic chromatin seen here.

24624.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓中巨噬細胞內含大量粗大黃褐色含鐵血黃素顆粒（右下插圖），B 圖普魯士藍染色顯示鐵集中在巨噬細胞內呈深藍色；C 圖示意 hepcidin 使 ferroportin 被內化降解，說明發炎/自體免疫疾病時鐵被困在巨噬細胞內。
features: Bone marrow macrophages packed with coarse golden-brown refractile hemosiderin granules (panel A inset)
Background of erythroid and myeloid precursors with intervening fat spaces
Prussian blue stain shows heavy, clumped blue iron deposits confined to macrophages (panel B)
Increased storage iron in macrophages; ring sideroblasts not evident
Panel C is a schematic of hepcidin-induced ferroportin internalization in enterocytes and macrophages
24624.describe_en: Bone marrow sections/aspirate show macrophages laden with coarse golden-brown hemosiderin pigment amid otherwise unremarkable hematopoietic precursors. An iron stain demonstrates markedly increased storage iron sequestered within macrophages, without evident ring sideroblasts in the illustrated field. The accompanying schematic depicts hepcidin binding ferroportin and triggering its lysosomal degradation, which blocks iron export from enterocytes and macrophages. In a patient with systemic autoimmune/inflammatory disease, findings are consistent with hepcidin-mediated macrophage iron sequestration (anemia of inflammation).

ddx.vs: Low hepcidin in HFE hemochromatosis causes parenchymal (hepatocyte) iron loading with relatively iron-poor macrophages, the opposite of this macrophage-predominant pattern.
Transfusional siderosis also loads macrophages but requires a history of multiple transfusions and shows markedly elevated ferritin with transferrin saturation often high.
Iron deficiency shows absent stainable marrow iron on Prussian blue, whereas storage iron is abundant here.
Ring sideroblasts show perinuclear iron granules within erythroblasts, not only macrophage iron as seen here.

24624.stain: H&E or Giemsa; Prussian blue; schematic

2672.recognize_zh: 周邊血高倍視野中央為一顆有核紅血球：圓形細胞核、染色質濃縮呈棋盤狀、無核仁，細胞質灰藍帶粉紅（多染性），大小介於小淋巴球之間；周圍紅血球有堆疊傾向，在骨髓瘤患者可提示紅血球串錢狀排列與骨髓浸潤造成的白血球/紅血球母細胞血症。
features: Nucleated red blood cell with a round, eccentric nucleus and coarse, clumped checkerboard chromatin
No nucleoli; moderately high N:C ratio
Moderate gray-blue to lilac cytoplasm (polychromatophilic normoblast)
Adjacent red cells overlapping in short stacks, suggestive of early rouleaux
Red cells show crenation and refractile drying artifact
2672.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a nucleated red blood cell with a round nucleus, coarsely clumped checkerboard chromatin and moderate gray-blue polychromatophilic cytoplasm, consistent with a polychromatophilic normoblast. Surrounding red cells overlap in short stacks suggestive of rouleaux, and several show drying artifact. No blasts or plasma cells are present in this field. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma, circulating nucleated red cells may indicate marrow infiltration (leukoerythroblastic reaction), and red cell stacking reflects increased paraprotein.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a smooth rim of sky-blue cytoplasm and less sharply clumped chromatin, whereas the normoblast has checkerboard chromatin and hemoglobin-tinged gray cytoplasm.
Plasma cells have abundant deep blue cytoplasm with an eccentric nucleus and a perinuclear Golgi hof.
Megakaryocytic cells have irregular granular cytoplasm with platelet budding rather than homogeneous gray-blue cytoplasm.

13040.recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血中的淋巴球細胞質邊緣呈細毛狀突起（hairy projections），右圖骨髓切片中細胞核彼此間隔均勻、周圍有清亮細胞質（fried-egg 外觀），兩者合起來是毛細胞白血病（HCL）的典型表現。
features: PB: medium-sized lymphoid cell with circumferential fine hair-like cytoplasmic projections
PB: round to oval nucleus with homogeneous chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm; a second smaller lymphoid cell nearby
BM biopsy: interstitial infiltrate of cells with oval/bean-shaped nuclei widely spaced by clear cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
BM biopsy: residual marrow fat with sparse normal hematopoiesis in the field
Background red cells show mild poikilocytosis
13040.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and moderate pale cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. The accompanying bone marrow biopsy shows an interstitial infiltrate of cells with oval and bean-shaped nuclei separated by abundant clear cytoplasm, imparting a fried-egg appearance, with little residual normal hematopoiesis in the field. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia, supported clinically by pancytopenia and splenomegaly; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123, annexin A1) and/or BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have prominent nucleoli, cause leukocytosis without monocytopenia, and are CD25/annexin A1 negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short projections and show intrasinusoidal/nodular marrow involvement, lacking CD103/CD25/annexin A1 co-expression.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shows broad-based villi and intrasinusoidal marrow infiltration, and is CD25 and annexin A1 negative.
Mast cells in marrow also have clear cytoplasm but form paratrabecular spindled aggregates with fibrosis and are tryptase/CD117 positive.

9392.recognize_zh: 手背與手指這些日曬部位散布糜爛、結痂、暗色痂皮與白色小丘疹（milia）及萎縮性疤痕，是遲發性皮膚紫質症（PCT）皮膚脆弱、起水泡後留疤的典型分布。
features: Multiple small erosions and dark hemorrhagic crusts on the dorsal hand and fingers
Pale atrophic scars and small whitish papules consistent with milia
Ruptured bullae and a larger crusted erosion on a fingertip/knuckle
Diffuse erythematous to dusky, sun-damaged skin background
Distribution restricted to a sun-exposed, trauma-prone site
9392.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the dorsal hand shows multiple erosions, hemorrhagic crusts and dark eschars, together with pale atrophic scars and small white milia over the dorsum and fingers. Intact tense bullae are not clearly seen, suggesting a later stage after blister rupture. The distribution on sun-exposed, mechanically fragile skin is characteristic of a photosensitive blistering porphyria. Findings are consistent with porphyria cutanea tarda, to be confirmed by elevated plasma/urine uroporphyrin and heptacarboxyl porphyrins with reduced hepatic uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity.

ddx.vs: Skin findings are identical, but plasma and urine porphyrin levels are normal.

These produce the same blistering skin lesions but may have acute neurovisceral attacks and show a distinctive plasma fluorescence peak (~626 nm in VP) and elevated fecal protoporphyrin/coproporphyrin.
It shows trauma-induced blisters with milia but normal porphyrins and linear IgG at the dermal-epidermal junction on direct immunofluorescence.
EPP causes painful non-blistering photosensitivity with minimal scarring and elevated erythrocyte protoporphyrin rather than uroporphyrin.

1200.recognize_zh: 體液抹片中大量分散的大型異型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質深藍嗜鹼性、核圓且部分有明顯核仁，少數細胞特別大（免疫母細胞至間變性外觀），背景混有紅血球與少量中性球；在積液中出現此形態應想到原發性積液淋巴瘤（PEL）。
features: Numerous discohesive large atypical lymphoid cells dispersed singly among red cells
Marked size variation, with scattered very large cells two to three times the size of most tumor cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with high N:C ratio and visible nucleoli in the larger cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some cells with a paler paranuclear zone or vacuoles (plasmablastic-immunoblastic appearance)
Occasional neutrophils and histiocytes in the background; fine cytologic detail limited at this magnification
1200.describe_en: Cytospin of an effusion shows a highly cellular population of discohesive large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round to irregular nuclei and visible nucleoli. There is marked variation in size, with scattered very large immunoblastic to anaplastic-appearing cells. Scattered neutrophils and histiocytes are present, and no cohesive epithelial groups are seen. Findings are consistent with involvement by a high-grade lymphoma with plasmablastic features, in keeping with primary effusion lymphoma; confirmation requires HHV8 (LANA-1) positivity and a null or plasmacytic phenotype (CD45+, CD138+, CD30+, lacking CD20/CD79a).

ddx.dx: Extracavitary or secondary effusion involvement by DLBCL
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells express CD20, PAX5 and CD79a and are HHV8 negative, whereas PEL lacks B-cell markers and is HHV8 positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma shares the plasmablastic phenotype but is HHV8 negative and usually forms solid oral or extranodal masses rather than lymphomatous effusion alone.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in effusion
ddx.vs: Carcinoma forms cohesive three-dimensional clusters and expresses keratin, and melanoma expresses S100/SOX10, while PEL cells are discohesive and CD45/CD138 positive.
Mesothelial cells show cohesive groups with windows, dense two-tone cytoplasm with a peripheral skirt and bland nuclei, and are calretinin/WT1 positive.

3696.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 左側為密集小淋巴球的濾泡區，右側可見成片胞質透明、核圓的細胞（單核球樣 B 細胞，monocytoid B cells），並有小群胞質淡嗜酸性的類上皮組織球侵入邊緣，這組合提示弓漿蟲淋巴結炎（toxoplasmosis）。
features: Dense aggregate of small mature lymphocytes on the left (follicle/mantle region)
Sheet of medium-sized cells with abundant clear to pale cytoplasm and round to bean-shaped nuclei on the right, consistent with monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and elongated vesicular nuclei at the interface
No well-formed granulomas, necrosis or multinucleated giant cells in the field
Occasional mitoses and scattered small vessels with red cells
3696.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a dense aggregate of small lymphocytes adjacent to a sheet of monocytoid B cells with abundant clear to pale cytoplasm and round to bean-shaped nuclei. Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are present, focally encroaching on the lymphoid aggregate. Well-formed granulomas, caseous necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not identified. These findings are consistent with the triad of toxoplasmic lymphadenitis (follicular hyperplasia, small epithelioid histiocyte clusters and monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia); serologic confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma shows monotonous monocytoid cells effacing architecture with light chain restriction, rather than reactive follicles with epithelioid clusters.
These form discrete well-formed (sometimes necrotizing) granulomas with giant cells rather than small ill-defined epithelioid clusters.
Cat-scratch disease shows stellate suppurative necrotizing granulomas with neutrophils, which are absent here.
Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg or LP cells within the mixed infiltrate.

1776.recognize_zh: 胸水抹片中只見一小群大型細胞，胞質豐富淡藍有空泡、邊緣呈毛邊狀，核圓形置中並有小核仁，其間夾有中性球；這些較像反應性間皮細胞或巨噬細胞，此視野看不到神經母細胞瘤的小圓細胞團，與標題僅部分相符。
features: Small group of large cells with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and fringed (ruffled) borders
Central round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; one binucleate-appearing cell
Adjacent smaller cell with a round nucleus and an intervening neutrophil
Separate vacuolated macrophage-like cells with folded nuclei
Very sparse cellularity; no cohesive clusters of small round tumor cells in this field
1776.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows low cellularity, with a small group of large cells having abundant vacuolated cytoplasm with ruffled borders and round central nuclei with small nucleoli, accompanied by vacuolated macrophages, a neutrophil and scattered red cells. The morphology in this field favors reactive mesothelial cells and histiocytes. No cohesive clusters of small round cells characteristic of metastatic neuroblastoma are present in this field; the image therefore only partially supports the stated diagnosis, and review of additional fields and immunocytochemistry would be required.

ddx.vs: Favored here: large cells with central nuclei, dense-to-vacuolated cytoplasm with microvillous borders, calretinin/WT1 positive.
Would appear as small round cells with high N:C ratio and nuclear molding in cohesive clusters, PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Forms three-dimensional clusters with large nucleoli and nuclear pleomorphism, positive for epithelial markers such as MOC-31/BerEP4.

1968.recognize_zh: 箭頭處為一顆圓形細胞，胞質充滿密集粗大的暗紫至棕紫色顆粒並覆蓋在核上、底色帶粉紅，是顆粒仍呈嗜鹼性染色的未成熟嗜伊紅前驅細胞；周圍同時可見原始細胞、前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞與帶狀核中性球，呈左移背景。
features: Arrowed round cell with cytoplasm densely packed with coarse dark purple to brownish granules on a pink background
Granules overlie and partly obscure the nucleus
Adjacent immature granulocytes: a blast-like cell with a nucleolus (upper left), a promyelocyte/myelocyte with azurophilic granules (top center)
Band neutrophil at the bottom and small lymphocytes nearby
Red cells are well spread in a monolayer with central pallor
1968.describe_en: Smear shows a left-shifted granulocytic population including a blast-like cell with a nucleolus, a granulated promyelocyte/myelocyte, a band neutrophil and small lymphocytes. The arrowed cell is a round granulocytic precursor with cytoplasm crowded by coarse dark purple granules on a pinkish background, partially obscuring the nucleus, consistent with an immature eosinophilic precursor with basophilic-staining primary granules. Whether this is blood or a hemodilute aspirate cannot be determined with certainty; if peripheral blood, the circulating precursors warrant evaluation for a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as CML or a leukoerythroblastic process.

ddx.vs: Granules are fewer, variable in size and blue-black without an underlying pink-orange cytoplasmic tone.
Has fine azurophilic granules, a perinuclear Golgi clear zone and a visible nucleus with nucleoli.
Typically larger and oval with uniform metachromatic granules around a central nucleus, uncommon in blood.

1328.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示下肢皮膚有數處邊界模糊的紫藍至黃綠色瘀青（ecchymoses），沒有點狀出血或明顯腫脹；在類澱粉沉積症合併後天性凝血因子 X 缺乏的病人，這類皮下出血是凝血因子缺乏型出血的表現，但照片本身無法確立病因。
features: Clinical photograph of a lower extremity with several poorly demarcated ecchymoses
Central violaceous-blue bruise with surrounding yellow-green discoloration indicating resolving hemorrhage
Additional faint purplish bruising on the proximal portion of the limb
No petechiae, palpable purpura, or hemarthrosis-type swelling evident
Overlying skin otherwise intact without ulceration
1328.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lower extremity shows several poorly demarcated ecchymoses with a central violaceous area and surrounding yellow-green discoloration, indicating hemorrhages of different ages. No petechiae, palpable purpura, or skin necrosis is seen. Superficial ecchymoses without petechiae favor a coagulation factor or vascular fragility defect over thrombocytopenia. In a patient with systemic AL amyloidosis, the appearance is compatible with bleeding from acquired factor X deficiency, which must be confirmed by prolonged PT and aPTT with a low factor X activity.

ddx.vs: Thrombocytopenic bleeding typically produces petechiae and mucosal bleeding, and platelet count would be low, whereas this image shows ecchymoses without petechiae.

ddx.dx: Anticoagulant or vitamin K deficiency coagulopathy
ddx.vs: These cause similar ecchymoses but show deficiency of multiple vitamin K-dependent factors correctable by vitamin K, rather than isolated factor X deficiency.
Acquired hemophilia causes extensive soft-tissue ecchymoses with an isolated prolonged aPTT and factor VIII inhibitor, with a normal PT.

ddx.dx: Senile purpura or amyloid vascular fragility
ddx.vs: Vascular fragility purpura occurs with normal coagulation studies and, in amyloidosis, often appears as periorbital pinch purpura.

2928.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，幾乎每一顆白血球周圍都有一小圈淡紫色血小板黏附，而白血球之間的游離血小板很少，這種遍布全片的規律分布提示 EDTA 引起的血小板衛星現象。
features: Low-power field with evenly spread normocytic red cells
Most leukocytes (predominantly neutrophils) are surrounded by small halos of adherent platelets
Free platelets between leukocytes are sparse
No large free platelet clumps or schistocytes identified
Cellular detail limited at this magnification
2928.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows evenly distributed normocytic red cells and scattered leukocytes. Nearly every leukocyte, predominantly neutrophils, is surrounded by a small halo of adherent platelets, while free platelets in the intervening field are sparse. Large free platelet clumps and schistocytes are not seen. Individual platelet and leukocyte morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, which will spuriously lower the automated platelet count.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows a uniform scarcity of platelets without platelets aggregated around leukocytes.
Clumping produces free-floating platelet aggregates, often at the feathered edge, rather than rosettes around leukocytes.
Organisms lie within neutrophil cytoplasm or free in plasma and stain darker and more uniformly than granular platelets.

2608.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆比周圍細胞大好幾倍的巨大原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），細胞質深藍、邊緣有小空泡，核大且染色質細緻，是微小病毒 B19 感染的典型線索。
features: Giant erythroid precursor several times the size of neighboring cells
Large round to oval nucleus with finely granular chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone
Smaller basophilic erythroblasts with small cytoplasmic vacuoles nearby
Background of maturing granulocytes and red cells
2608.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant pronormoblast that is several times larger than surrounding myeloid cells. It has a large round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear zone. Nearby, smaller basophilic erythroblasts contain scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Distinct intranuclear inclusions are not appreciated on this aspirate. Findings are suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection, and correlation with B19 PCR or immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytic cells usually show cytoplasmic blebs or granules and are CD41/CD61 positive, whereas this cell has a dark-blue rim with a perinuclear halo typical of an erythroid precursor.
Pure erythroid leukemia presents as sheets of proerythroblasts, whereas here the giant cell is isolated amid a maturing background.
Tumor cells tend to form cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and lack the erythroid perinuclear clearing and deep-blue cytoplasm.
Plasma cells have an eccentric nucleus with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear Golgi hof, not a central large nucleus with fine chromatin.

1072.recognize_zh: 中央分節中性球細胞質中有較粗的紫紅色毒性顆粒，細胞質左上緣有一個小的淡藍色斑點，符合 Döhle 小體；此例的 Döhle 小體較小而細微。
features: Segmented neutrophil with increased, coarse purple cytoplasmic granulation
Small pale blue inclusion at the upper left cytoplasmic periphery (Döhle body)
Three nuclear lobes with condensed chromatin
Background normocytic red cells with occasional crenated forms; platelets present
1072.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil with coarse cytoplasmic granulation and a small pale blue inclusion at the periphery of the cytoplasm, consistent with a Döhle body. The background red cells are normocytic with occasional crenated forms, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with toxic neutrophil changes associated with infection or inflammation.

ddx.vs: MYH9-related inclusions are larger, crisply defined and present in nearly all neutrophils, with macrothrombocytopenia.
Overstaining darkens granules in all cells uniformly without producing discrete pale blue peripheral inclusions.
Chédiak-Higashi neutrophils contain a few giant, irregular gray-pink granules rather than small pale blue ER remnants.

1136.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片顆粒周圍布滿大型單一形態的母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，胞質豐富呈灰藍色並有小空泡，屬單核母細胞（monoblast）/前單核球，符合急性單核球性白血病。
features: Sheets of large, monotonous blasts surrounding a marrow particle
Round to slightly oval nuclei with fine, delicate chromatin; occasional nucleoli
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with scattered small vacuoles
Low N:C ratio relative to lymphoblasts
Near-absence of maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors in the field
1136.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle surrounded by sheets of large, monotonous blasts that replace normal hematopoiesis. The cells have round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing small vacuoles. Maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements are markedly reduced. The cellular detail is limited at this magnification, but the findings are consistent with acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD4) are recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal maturation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have higher N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm, are MPO positive and NSE negative.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharp lipid vacuoles and a mature B-cell phenotype.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, and are CD138 positive.

4144.recognize_zh: 這是一張正面胸部 X 光片（PA view），不是形態學影像；重點在觀察縱膈輪廓是否增寬以評估 T-ALL/LBL 常見的前縱膈腫塊，本片縱膈上部輪廓略顯突出，但無明顯巨大腫塊或肋膜積液。
features: Frontal (PA) chest radiograph
Superior mediastinal contour mildly prominent without a clearly bulky mass
Cardiac silhouette within normal size
Lungs clear without consolidation; no pleural effusion
Normal airway midline without obvious tracheal deviation
4144.describe_en: This is a frontal chest radiograph rather than a morphologic image. The superior mediastinal contour appears mildly prominent, but there is no clearly bulky mediastinal mass, tracheal deviation or pleural effusion, and the lungs are clear. In T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, chest imaging is used to detect an anterior mediastinal (thymic) mass that may cause airway or SVC compromise; this film may represent a baseline or post-treatment study and CT would better define any residual mass.

3888.recognize_zh: 有幾顆紅血球靠近邊緣處有一小群細小、深藍紫色的顆粒聚在一起，而不是均勻分布在整個細胞，這種成簇的周邊顆粒就是 Pappenheimer bodies（含鐵顆粒）。
features: A few red cells contain small clusters of fine, dark blue-purple granules located near the cell periphery
Granules are aggregated in one or two clumps rather than evenly dispersed
Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional crenated cells and drying artifacts
A single small lymphocyte is present
3888.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered red cells containing small peripheral clusters of fine basophilic granules, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. The inclusions are grouped rather than diffusely distributed, distinguishing them from basophilic stippling. The remaining red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional crenated forms, and a normal-appearing small lymphocyte is present. Findings are consistent with Pappenheimer bodies; confirmation as siderotic granules with a Prussian blue stain is recommended, and splenic hypofunction, sideroblastic anemia or hemolysis should be considered.

ddx.vs: Stippling consists of fine granules evenly scattered throughout the whole red cell and is Prussian blue-negative, whereas Pappenheimer bodies form peripheral clusters and are iron-positive.
Howell-Jolly bodies are usually a single larger, round, dense nuclear remnant rather than a cluster of tiny granules.

ddx.dx: Platelets or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets are larger with a pale-staining hyalomere, and stain precipitate is also seen in the background away from red cells.

3824.recognize_zh: 高倍脾臟切片中滿布大型組織球，細胞質淡染並充滿細小空泡、呈泡沫或網狀，核小而位於中央或偏位，細胞邊界清楚，是 Niemann-Pick 病典型的泡沫細胞。
features: Sheets of large polygonal histiocytes with sharply defined cell borders
Abundant pale cytoplasm filled with fine clear vacuoles (foamy/bubbly)
Small, round, dark nuclei, central or eccentric, low N:C ratio
Occasional faint granular material within the vacuolated cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes and red cells between storage cells
3824.describe_en: High-power section of spleen shows sheets of large polygonal histiocytes with sharply defined borders and abundant pale cytoplasm distended by fine, uniform clear vacuoles, imparting a foamy appearance. Nuclei are small, round, and bland. Scattered small lymphocytes and red cells lie between the storage cells. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of Niemann-Pick disease involving the spleen.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have eosinophilic striated 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than clear bubbly vacuoles.
Hairy cells are smaller lymphoid cells with oval/bean-shaped nuclei and clear cytoplasm halos, and are B-cell marker positive.
Infected histiocytes contain acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain, which is negative in storage disease.
Clear cell carcinoma is cohesive with atypical nuclei and is keratin positive, whereas these cells have bland small nuclei and are CD68 positive.

3760.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中除了分葉核嗜中性球外，還出現兩顆較大的細胞，細胞質佈滿深紫色粗大顆粒、幾乎遮住細胞核，屬於帶粗顆粒的未成熟顆粒球（前骨髓細胞／骨髓細胞）；嗜中性球細胞質也偏泡沫狀、顆粒明顯。這種左移加上顆粒增多，符合使用 G-CSF 後的反應。
features: Two large cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse purple granules partly obscuring the nucleus (immature granulocytes, promyelocyte/myelocyte stage)
Segmented and band neutrophils with increased cytoplasmic granulation
Some neutrophil cytoplasm appears pale and faintly vacuolated
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
Platelets present, not clumped
3760.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with increased, coarse cytoplasmic granulation and early left shift. Two large cells with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure nuclear detail are present, consistent with circulating promyelocytes/myelocytes. Red cells are normocytic without notable poikilocytosis, and platelets are adequate. No blasts or dysplastic features are evident in this field, although nuclear detail of the granular cells is limited. In the setting of recent growth factor therapy, findings are consistent with G-CSF effect.

ddx.vs: APL shows numerous abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei, Auer rods/faggot cells and coagulopathy, rather than a few granular precursors in a background of maturing neutrophils.
CML shows marked leukocytosis with a full myeloid spectrum, myelocyte bulge, basophilia and BCR-ABL1, whereas G-CSF effect is transient with a clear therapy history.
Infection also causes toxic granulation and left shift but usually with Döhle bodies and vacuoles; the distinction rests on clinical context and resolution after drug withdrawal.

3632.recognize_zh: 標題寫的是細胞散佈圖（cytogram），但這張其實是周邊血抹片，看得到兩顆正常的分葉中性球：有 3–4 個分葉、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質裡有淡粉紫色的細顆粒；紅血球和血小板也沒有異常。
features: Two mature segmented neutrophils, about 2 times RBC diameter
Nuclei with 3-4 lobes connected by thin filaments and coarsely clumped chromatin
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine, evenly distributed neutrophilic granules; no toxic granulation, vacuoles, or Döhle bodies
Normochromic, normocytic RBCs with central pallor
Scattered normal-sized platelets
3632.describe_en: Although the title refers to a cytogram, this image is a peripheral blood smear rather than an analyzer scatter plot. It shows two mature segmented neutrophils with 3-4 nuclear lobes, clumped chromatin, and finely granular pink cytoplasm without toxic change, hypersegmentation, or hypogranularity. Red cells are normochromic and normocytic, and platelets are normal in size. Findings represent normal neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have 6 or more lobes or more than 5% with 5 lobes, often with macro-ovalocytes, whereas these cells have 3-4 lobes.
Toxic neutrophils show coarse dark granules, cytoplasmic vacuoles, and Döhle bodies, all absent here.
Dysplastic neutrophils have pale, agranular cytoplasm or pseudo-Pelger bilobed nuclei, unlike the normal granulation and segmentation here.

3568.recognize_zh: 視野左側有一顆接近紅血球大小、帶紫色顆粒的巨大血小板（giant platelet），旁邊可比對一顆正常小血小板；結合標題即指向 MYH9 相關疾病（May-Hegglin anomaly）。本圖只見嗜酸性球，看不到嗜中性球中的 Döhle-like 包涵體。
features: Giant platelet approaching the diameter of a small red cell, with central purple granulomere and pale hyalomere
Normal-sized platelet nearby for comparison, highlighting platelet size heterogeneity
Central eosinophil with bilobed nucleus and abundant orange-red granules; no neutrophil present to assess for Döhle-like inclusions
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
Overall paucity of platelets in the field, compatible with thrombocytopenia
3568.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with few platelets in the field. A giant platelet approaching red-cell size is present adjacent to an unremarkable eosinophil, with a normal-sized platelet nearby. No neutrophils are present in this field, so the characteristic basophilic Döhle-like cytoplasmic inclusions cannot be evaluated here. In the appropriate context, macrothrombocytopenia is suggestive of an MYH9-related disorder (May-Hegglin anomaly).

ddx.vs: Also shows giant platelets but lacks neutrophil inclusions and has absent ristocetin-induced agglutination due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
Large platelets are pale gray and agranular owing to alpha-granule deficiency, whereas this platelet retains purple granules.
Large young platelets may be seen, but truly giant platelets and neutrophil Döhle-like inclusions are absent and MYH9 immunofluorescence is normal.
Reactive Döhle bodies accompany toxic granulation in infection and are not associated with giant platelets.

3376.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染（reticulin stain）下，黑色纖維粗厚、呈束狀平行流線並大量交錯，遠超過正常稀疏細纖維，並夾雜黃褐色含鐵血黃素顆粒，代表明顯網狀纖維增生。
features: Coarse, thick black argyrophilic fibers in streaming parallel bundles
Extensive fiber intersections with focal dense clumps
Pale green-counterstained residual cells entrapped between fibers
Scattered yellow-brown refractile pigment clumps (hemosiderin in macrophages)
Diffuse increase rather than focal perivascular distribution
3376.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy stained for reticulin (silver impregnation with light green counterstain) shows a diffuse, dense increase in coarse, thick reticulin fibers arranged in streaming bundles with extensive intersections. Residual marrow cells are entrapped between fibers, and scattered yellow-brown pigmented macrophages consistent with hemosiderin are seen. The fiber density corresponds to a high-grade reticulin fibrosis (approximately MF-2 to MF-3; confirmation of collagen requires trichrome). Findings are consistent with marked marrow fibrosis; etiology requires correlation with H&E morphology and clinical findings.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow shows only scattered fine linear fibers without intersections, mostly around vessels, unlike the coarse dense bundles here.
PMF is favored when the fibrosis accompanies clusters of atypical cloud-like megakaryocytes and a driver mutation, which the silver stain alone cannot show.
HCL produces a fine, delicate, diffuse reticulin mesh around individual fried-egg lymphoid cells rather than coarse streaming bundles.

3248.recognize_zh: 空泡化巨噬細胞邊緣有數個小橢圓形酵母菌，具透亮暈圈與偏心紫色染色質，旁邊還有游離的相同菌體；周圍有中性球系列細胞，符合 Histoplasma capsulatum 感染。
features: Vacuolated macrophages with folded nuclei and foamy cytoplasm
Small oval yeasts with clear halos and eccentric chromatin at the edge of a macrophage
Extracellular yeast forms near the red cells, likely released by smearing
Adjacent neutrophil-lineage cells (band/metamyelocyte) and vacuolated monocytoid cells
No hyphae or large capsules
3248.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows several vacuolated macrophages and granulocytic cells. Clustered at the edge of one macrophage and extending into the adjacent background are several small, uniform oval yeast forms with clear halos and eccentric chromatin, some extracellular, likely released from ruptured macrophage cytoplasm. No hyphae or thick capsules are present. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum infection; confirmatory GMS stain, antigen assay or culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Candida glabrata yeasts are similar in size but lack the Wright-stain halo, and species identification requires culture.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucoid capsule and narrow-based budding.
Amastigotes have a kinetoplast adjacent to the nucleus and no halo.
Precipitate and platelets are irregular granular particles without a refractile wall, halo and internal crescentic chromatin.

3184.recognize_zh: 抹片中成群大型異常前骨髓細胞，胞質充滿密集的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒，部分胞核呈雙葉或腎形折疊，符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）；此視野未見Niemann-Pick泡沫細胞。
features: Clusters of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm heavily packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules, partly obscuring the nucleus
Nuclei reniform, folded or bilobed with fine chromatin
Pale blue agranular cytoplasmic rim at the periphery of some cells
Two small cells with dense round nuclei (erythroid precursors or lymphocytes) in the background
No foamy storage histiocytes or Auer rod bundles clearly identified in this field
3184.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows clusters of large abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules. Many nuclei are folded, reniform or bilobed, with fine chromatin partially obscured by granules. Rare small nucleated cells are present in the background, and no storage histiocytes are seen in this particular field. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; confirmation of PML::RARA is required and should be pursued urgently given coagulopathy risk.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear Golgi hof and show orderly maturation to myelocytes, rather than sheets of cells with folded bilobed nuclei.
AML with maturation has myeloblasts with fewer granules and occasional single Auer rods, and lacks sheets of heavily granulated bilobed promyelocytes and PML::RARA.
Monocytic cells have folded nuclei but gray-blue cytoplasm with fine sparse granules and are NSE positive, unlike the strongly MPO-positive hypergranular APL cells.

3120.recognize_zh: 單顆淋巴球核呈卵圓形且略偏位、染色質塊狀，胞質較一般淋巴球豐富且嗜鹼偏藍灰，外觀介於淋巴球與漿細胞之間，即漿細胞樣淋巴球（plasmacytoid lymphocyte）。
features: Small-to-intermediate lymphocyte, slightly larger than a mature small lymphocyte
Oval, slightly eccentric nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin
No visible nucleolus
Moderate amount of basophilic, finely textured cytoplasm without a distinct perinuclear hof
Background normocytic red cells
3120.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single lymphocyte with an oval, slightly eccentric nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, no visible nucleolus, and a moderate rim of basophilic cytoplasm. A well-developed perinuclear hof is not present. Findings are consistent with a plasmacytoid lymphocyte, a reactive variant seen in viral infections and immune responses; if numerous, lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma should be considered.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have a markedly eccentric nucleus, abundant deep blue cytoplasm, and a clear perinuclear hof.
Small lymphocytes have a central round nucleus with only a scant rim of cytoplasm.
Neoplastic plasmacytoid cells are numerous and clonal by flow cytometry with IgM paraprotein, which cannot be judged from a single cell.

2864.recognize_zh: 低中倍切片：組織被形態一致、瀰漫片狀生長的小至中型圓核細胞完全取代，無正常結構；中央有一團核較深染的細胞聚集在血管周圍，符合淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤的瀰漫浸潤。
features: Diffuse effacement by sheets of monotonous small- to intermediate-sized round cells
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and fine chromatin
Central perivascular aggregate of more hyperchromatic cells
Scattered red cells and delicate vessels; no follicles or residual normal architecture
2864.describe_en: Low- to intermediate-power H&E section shows diffuse effacement of tissue architecture by sheets of monotonous small- to intermediate-sized round cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and fine chromatin. A central aggregate of more hyperchromatic cells surrounds a small vessel. No residual follicles or normal structures are identified. Findings are consistent with a diffuse high-grade lymphoid neoplasm, compatible with lymphoblastic lymphoma; cytologic detail at higher power and TdT immunostaining are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger (>2x lymphocyte size) with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and are TdT negative.
SLL cells have coarse clumped chromatin and show proliferation centers rather than fine blastic chromatin.

ddx.dx: Ewing sarcoma/small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is CD45 negative and CD99/NKX2-2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement, whereas lymphoblasts are CD45 and TdT positive.

2800.recognize_zh: 單顆大型中性球核分成六葉以上（hypersegmented），細胞質有細緻顆粒，旁邊還有淚滴狀紅血球；此圖呈現的是顆粒球系發育異常，而非單核球增多本身，需結合全片單核球計數才支持 CMML。
features: Large segmented neutrophil with hypersegmented nucleus (about 6 or more lobes)
Coarsely clumped chromatin in lobes connected by thin filaments
Abundant cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules; granulation not reduced
Background red cells include a teardrop cell and mild anisocytosis
Scattered small platelets; no monocytes in this field
2800.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged neutrophil with a hypersegmented nucleus composed of multiple small lobes and cytoplasm with fine granules. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with a teardrop form, and platelets are present. No monocytes are included in this field, so the defining monocytosis cannot be evaluated here. Nuclear hypersegmentation may represent dysgranulopoiesis in a myeloid neoplasm such as chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, but megaloblastic change should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows macro-ovalocytes and several hypersegmented neutrophils with normal vitamin levels excluding it; CMML additionally shows monocytosis.
Drug-induced hypersegmentation is explained by history and accompanied by macrocytosis rather than monocytosis.
Pelger-Huet dysplasia shows hyposegmented bilobed or nonlobed nuclei, the opposite of the hypersegmented nucleus here.
Constitutional hypersegmentation is present in all neutrophils without cytopenias or dysplasia in other lineages.

2736.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中兩顆巨大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富成熟，細胞核高度分葉並呈鹿角狀（staghorn）堆疊；這種大型、過度分葉的成熟巨核細胞是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的特徵。
features: Two very large megakaryocytes, many times the size of surrounding cells
Hyperlobulated, deeply folded 'staghorn' nuclei
Abundant mature, finely granular pale purple cytoplasm
No hypolobated, small or bare-nuclei dysplastic forms in this field
Background of maturing hematopoietic cells and red cells
2736.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two large megakaryocytes with abundant mature granular cytoplasm and markedly hyperlobulated, deeply folded 'staghorn' nuclei. Surrounding hematopoietic cells show maturing lymphoid, granulocytic and erythroid elements without increased blasts in this field. Large, mature, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes are the characteristic morphologic finding of essential thrombocythemia. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical context (sustained thrombocytosis, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, exclusion of reactive causes and other myeloid neoplasms).

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like hypolobated nuclei and high N:C ratio, forming dense clusters, rather than mature staghorn forms.
PV shows pleomorphic megakaryocytes of variable size with panmyelosis and elevated hemoglobin, not predominantly giant hyperlobated forms.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normal in size and lobation without the giant staghorn morphology.
5q- syndrome shows small, hypolobated or monolobated megakaryocytes rather than hyperlobated giant forms.

2480.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中間一個大型單核球，核呈腎形／摺疊、染色質花邊狀、胞質灰藍豐富，旁邊兩個中性球；兒童血片中單核球增多是 JMML 的核心診斷條件（絕對單核球數 ≥1×10⁹/L）。
features: Large monocyte with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and a folded, kidney-shaped nucleus with lacy chromatin
Two segmented neutrophils with normal granulation
Red cells with mild anisocytosis, occasional target cells and an elongated echinocyte
Scattered small platelets
No blasts in this field
2480.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature-appearing monocyte with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and a folded, reniform nucleus with lacy chromatin, accompanied by two segmented neutrophils. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with occasional target cells and an echinocyte, and platelets are present in small numbers. No blasts are seen in this field. A single monocyte is nonspecific, but an absolute monocytosis in a young child is a required criterion for juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia and should prompt a full differential count and molecular evaluation.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytosis accompanies infection or inflammation without immature myeloid cells, nucleated red cells, thrombocytopenia or clonal mutations.
CMML shows similar mature monocytosis but occurs in adults.
Promonocytes have more delicate chromatin, visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm than this mature monocyte.

2224.recognize_zh: 滿視野的顆粒球系細胞從早幼粒到帶狀核都有，許多嗜中性球顆粒稀少、核形不規則或分葉不良，缺乏明顯嗜鹼性球增多，是 BCR-ABL1 陰性 aCML 常見的發育不良顆粒球增生。
features: Hypercellular granulocytic proliferation with all stages of maturation
Numerous myelocytes and metamyelocytes with pale, hypogranular cytoplasm
Irregular, bizarre or hyposegmented neutrophil nuclei (dysgranulopoiesis)
Occasional promyelocytes with azurophilic granules; blasts not increased
Scattered erythroid precursors; basophils not conspicuous
2224.describe_en: Aspirate smear (likely bone marrow) is hypercellular and dominated by granulocytic precursors spanning promyelocytes to band and segmented forms. Many maturing neutrophils show hypogranular cytoplasm and irregular or abnormally segmented nuclei, indicating dysgranulopoiesis. Blasts are not increased in this field, and basophils and monocytes are not prominent. Findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm such as atypical chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR-ABL1-negative, pending molecular exclusion of BCR-ABL1 and assessment of CSF3R/SETBP1 status.

ddx.vs: CML features a myelocyte bulge with basophilia and eosinophilia and minimal dysplasia, confirmed by t(9;22)/BCR-ABL1.
CNL consists mainly of mature segmented neutrophils with toxic granulation and lacks dysgranulopoiesis.
MDS is usually cytopenic with increased blasts rather than a leukocytosis with abundant maturing granulocytes.

2160.recognize_zh: 高倍下多數為大型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻，周圍一圈中等量深藍色胞質、偶見少許細顆粒，視野中僅見一個小淋巴球與一個成熟中細胞，缺乏顆粒球系成熟階段，支持 AML without maturation。
features: Large blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei
Finely granular, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli indistinct at this resolution
Moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, occasionally with sparse fine azurophilic granules
No Auer rods identified
Maturing granulocytic cells essentially absent; rare small lymphocyte and single maturing myeloid cell
2160.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows sheets of large blasts with round to slightly indented nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and a moderate rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a few containing sparse fine azurophilic granules. Auer rods are not seen. Maturing granulocytic precursors are virtually absent, with only a rare lymphocyte and an occasional maturing myeloid cell present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation.

ddx.vs: Requires ≥10% maturing granulocytic cells beyond the blast stage, which are not present in this field.
The presence of any cytoplasmic azurophilic granules favors myeloid blasts; ALL is MPO-negative with lymphoid markers on flow.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray cytoplasm and folded nuclei, and are NSE positive and CD14/CD64 positive.
APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with many fine granules or Auer rod bundles and are strongly MPO positive with PML::RARA.

2096.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，雖然背景有大量成熟中的顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞，箭頭指出數顆較大、染色質細緻、細胞質少的母細胞（blast），混在其中，是提示復發 B-ALL 的線索。
features: Scattered larger blasts (arrows) with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Blasts are admixed with abundant maturing granulocytes (myelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils)
Numerous small cells with dense round nuclei, representing erythroid precursors and mature lymphocytes
Cellular aspirate with trilineage elements; blasts are not the dominant population in this field
No granules or Auer rods evident in the arrowed blasts
2096.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power is cellular, with a mixed population of maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes. Scattered larger blasts (arrows) with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular cytoplasm are present among the normal hematopoietic elements. Blast percentage cannot be reliably estimated from a single field, and lineage assignment requires flow cytometry. In the clinical setting of prior precursor B lymphoblastic leukemia, the findings are suggestive of relapse.

ddx.vs: Hematogones are smaller with homogeneous, smudged chromatin and show a normal maturational antigen continuum on flow cytometry, whereas relapsed B-ALL shows an aberrant, clustered immunophenotype.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia (therapy-related or lineage switch)
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts often show granules or Auer rods and are MPO positive, whereas lymphoblasts are agranular and MPO negative with CD19/CD79a expression.
Post-chemotherapy regeneration shows left-shifted but orderly maturation with promyelocytes and myelocytes, without a discrete population of immature blasts by flow cytometry.

2032.recognize_zh: 左側為淡粉紅、細胞輪廓模糊但仍隱約可見的凝固性壞死（coagulative necrosis），右側是密集的多形性淋巴樣浸潤並夾雜血管；這種壞死鄰接多形性浸潤的組合常見於多形性 PTLD（polymorphic PTLD）。
features: Pale eosinophilic zone of coagulative necrosis with ghost cell outlines on the left
Dense cellular infiltrate with mixed small and larger nuclei on the right
Sharp but irregular interface between necrosis and viable infiltrate
Scattered small blood vessels and focal hemorrhage in the viable area
Few eosinophilic cellular clumps at the edge of necrosis
Individual cell detail limited at this magnification
