2032.describe_en: Low-to-intermediate power H&E section shows a large zone of coagulative necrosis with ghost cell outlines on the left, abutting a dense viable infiltrate on the right composed of cells of varying nuclear size with scattered small vessels and focal hemorrhage. Fine cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are consistent with polymorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder with geographic necrosis, which should prompt EBER in situ hybridization and clonality assessment.

ddx.vs: Monomorphic PTLD shows necrosis adjacent to sheets of uniformly large transformed B cells rather than a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasma cells and immunoblasts.
Infectious necrosis is typically suppurative or granulomatous with neutrophils or histiocytes and demonstrable organisms, not a lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with EBV-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma or lymphomatoid granulomatosis
ddx.vs: These show angiocentric infiltrates with vessel destruction and CD56+ cytotoxic T/NK cells or EBV-positive large B cells in a T-cell background.

1840.recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中成群出現的芽細胞，核圓、大小相近、細胞質極少，染色質細緻而深染，與右下角的小型成熟淋巴球相比明顯較大，並可見幾顆被推擠變形的細胞；背景紅血球密集，推測為周邊血或稀釋的骨髓抹片。
features: Clusters of round blasts about 2 times the diameter of a red cell with very high N:C ratio
Round, regular nuclei with fine but dark-staining chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to barely visible agranular cytoplasm
Occasional crushed/smudged cells with streaked chromatin
Small mature lymphocyte (lower right) for size comparison; abundant erythrocytes in the background
1840.describe_en: Smear with a dense erythrocyte background shows clusters of relatively uniform blasts approximately twice the size of a red cell. The blasts have very high N:C ratios, round regular nuclei, fine dark-staining chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant agranular cytoplasm. A few smudged cells and a small mature lymphocyte are present; no Auer rods are identified. Whether this is peripheral blood or a hemodilute marrow aspirate cannot be determined with certainty from this field. Findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts of B-lymphoblastic leukemia, pending flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Indistinguishable morphologically; cytoplasmic CD3 by flow defines T lineage and T-ALL often presents with a mediastinal mass and high WBC.
Cells are smaller with coarse clumped chromatin and numerous smudge cells and are CD5/CD23 positive, TdT-negative.
Lymphocytes are small mature cells with cleaved or clefted nuclei and condensed chromatin, not blasts.
Requires MPO cytochemistry or myeloid antigen expression by flow to exclude.

1584.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下絕大多數是小型、核呈角狀或有切跡的中心細胞（centrocytes），染色質深、核仁不明顯，大型具核仁的中心母細胞（centroblasts）只零星出現，符合低級別（grade 1-2）濾泡型淋巴瘤。
features: Sheets of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and high N:C ratio
Predominance of centrocytes with angulated, elongated, cleaved or twisted nuclei
Dense, dark chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli in most cells
Only rare larger centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and peripheral nucleoli
Monotonous population without tingible-body macrophages or significant mitotic activity
1584.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a monotonous population of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm. Most cells are centrocytes with angulated, cleaved and irregular nuclei, dense chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Large centroblasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli are infrequent, and tingible-body macrophages are not seen. Findings are consistent with low-grade (grade 1-2) follicular lymphoma, assuming this field is representative of a follicle.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells have more uniform, slightly irregular nuclei without admixed centroblasts, often with hyalinized vessels and epithelioid histiocytes, and are cyclin D1-positive.
SLL cells are round with clumped chromatin and form proliferation centers containing prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts rather than cleaved centrocytes.
Grade 3A requires more than 15 centroblasts per high-power field, whereas centroblasts here are sparse.

1520.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀 CD4（PE）對 CD8（FITC）散點圖，閘選細胞幾乎全部落在左上象限，呈 CD4 陽性、CD8 陰性的單一族群，符合 T-PLL 最常見的 CD4+/CD8- 表現型。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot with CD8 FITC on the x-axis and CD4 PE on the y-axis
A single tight population in the upper-left quadrant (CD4 positive at about 10^3, CD8 negative)
Virtual absence of CD8-positive or double-negative events in the gated population
Plot labeled CD4+/CD8-, indicating a restricted T-cell subset
1520.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD4 versus CD8 on the gated lymphoid population shows a single, tight, homogeneous population that is CD4-positive and CD8-negative, with virtually no CD8-positive T cells. Such marked restriction to one subset indicates an expanded, likely clonal CD4-positive T-cell population rather than a normal polyclonal mixture. In the context of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, this represents the most common CD4+/CD8- phenotype; co-expression of CD4 and CD8 or CD8-only expression occurs in a minority of cases.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells are also CD4+/CD8- but typically lose CD7 and CD26, whereas T-PLL is usually CD7-bright and TCL1-positive.
ATLL is CD4+/CD8- but CD25-bright and CD7-negative, with HTLV-1 positivity.
Reactive states retain a CD8 population and show no aberrant antigen loss or clonal TCR rearrangement.

1456.recognize_zh: 整片以大型母細胞為主：核圓、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質少至中量藍色且無顆粒，其間夾雜染色質濃縮的小型深染細胞；在 CML 病史下，這種母細胞取代成熟顆粒球系列的樣貌代表急變期（blast crisis）。
features: Sheet of large blasts, about 2-3 times the size of the small dark cells
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale basophilic, agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Interspersed smaller cells with dense, condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm (lymphocytes or late erythroid precursors)
Maturing granulocytes, basophils and eosinophils are not evident in this field
Vacuole-like clear spaces consistent with smear artifact
1456.describe_en: Smear, most likely bone marrow aspirate, shows a predominance of large blasts with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and a moderate rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Scattered small cells with condensed chromatin are interspersed, and the maturing granulocytic spectrum typical of chronic-phase CML is not seen in this field. In a patient with BCR-ABL1-positive CML, these findings are consistent with blast crisis; lineage (myeloid versus lymphoid) cannot be determined morphologically and requires cytochemistry (MPO) and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar; history of CML, persistent basophilia/splenomegaly and BCR-ABL1 with additional abnormalities favor blast crisis.
Ph+ B-ALL can mimic lymphoid blast crisis; presence of BCR-ABL1 in myeloid lineages and a prior chronic phase favor CML.
Accelerated phase has fewer blasts (<20%) with persistent maturing granulocytes, rather than blasts replacing the marrow.
Proerythroblasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blebs and coarse chromatin and occur with a full erythroid maturation spectrum.

60400.recognize_zh: 中央的嗜中性球核分成 6 葉以上，背景紅血球大小不一、偏大且呈卵圓形（macro-ovalocytes），並可見淚滴狀細胞，符合維生素 B12 缺乏造成的核過度分葉嗜中性球（hypersegmented neutrophil）。
features: Neutrophil with six or more distinct nuclear lobes connected by fine filaments
Condensed chromatin with fine specific granules in pale cytoplasm
Background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes
Occasional teardrop-shaped red cells
No toxic granulation or Döhle bodies in the neutrophil
60400.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous large oval red cells (macro-ovalocytes) and occasional teardrop forms. A neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes is present. The combination of macro-ovalocytes and neutrophil hypersegmentation indicates megaloblastic hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with a hypersegmented neutrophil in megaloblastic anemia, here due to vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normal neutrophils have 2-5 lobes, whereas this cell has at least six.
The inherited form lacks macro-ovalocytes and has normal B12/folate levels; morphology of the neutrophil alone cannot separate them.
MDS usually shows hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger neutrophils and cytopenias with normal B12/folate, whereas this smear shows granulated hypersegmented neutrophils with macro-ovalocytes.
Drug-induced megaloblastic change looks identical morphologically and is distinguished by medication history and vitamin levels.

112.recognize_zh: 小腸壁被一大塊單調、瀰漫成片的中型至大型淋巴瘤細胞取代，可見星空樣（starry-sky）易染體巨噬細胞、大量核分裂與凋亡小體；免疫染色顯示腫瘤多數細胞呈核染色，且 MYC 與 BCL2 斷裂分離（break-apart）FISH 皆出現紅綠訊號分開，支持 MYC 與 BCL2 雙重轉位（double-hit）。
features: Diffuse, monotonous sheets of medium-to-large lymphoid cells effacing the bowel wall and dissecting between smooth muscle bundles
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with vesicular to finely granular chromatin and small, often multiple nucleoli; scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Brisk mitotic activity, numerous apoptotic bodies and scattered tingible-body macrophages (starry-sky pattern)

IHC: tumor cells show strong membranous staining for a B-cell/germinal-center-type marker, a high fraction of nuclear-positive cells, and only scattered small positive reactive cells on a T-cell-type stain (markers not labeled in images)
FISH: MYC break-apart probe with one fused and one split red/green signal pair; BCL2 break-apart probe likewise shows one fused and one split signal pair
112.describe_en: Sections of a resected small bowel/mesenteric mass show a large, transmural lymphoid neoplasm that underlies intact mucosa and infiltrates the muscularis propria. The tumor grows in diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-to-large cells with vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, numerous mitoses and apoptotic bodies, and scattered tingible-body macrophages imparting a starry-sky appearance. Immunohistochemical stains (markers not labeled in the images) show a diffusely positive neoplastic B-cell population with a high proportion of nuclear-positive cells, while background small T cells are scattered. Dual-color break-apart FISH demonstrates split signals for both MYC and BCL2. Findings are consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit lymphoma).

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma is more uniformly medium-sized, BCL2-negative or weak, has Ki-67 near 100%, and carries MYC rearrangement without a concurrent BCL2 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS (MYC/BCL2 double-expressor)
ddx.vs: Can look identical on H&E and IHC; only FISH separates them, as double-expressor DLBCL lacks concurrent MYC and BCL2 translocations.
Blastoid mantle cell lymphoma shares a blastoid, high-mitotic morphology but is CD5+ and cyclin D1/SOX11+ with t(11;14) and is usually CD10-negative.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finer, blastic chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli and is TdT-positive, whereas double-hit lymphoma is a TdT-negative mature germinal-center B-cell neoplasm.

112.stain: H&E; IHC (markers not labeled); FISH MYC/BCL2 break-apart
captions: Scanning view: small bowel wall with intact mucosa overlying a large transmural lymphoid mass
Low power: diffuse monotonous sheets with scattered tingible-body macrophages (starry-sky)
Tumor cells infiltrating and dissecting muscularis propria smooth muscle bundles
Intermediate power: sheets of medium-to-large cells with starry-sky macrophages and mitoses
High power: vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli, numerous mitoses and apoptotic bodies
IHC (marker not labeled): strong membranous staining of most tumor cells
IHC (marker not labeled): scattered positive small reactive cells; tumor cells negative
IHC (marker not labeled): weaker membranous staining across the tumor cells
IHC (nuclear marker, not labeled): majority of tumor nuclei positive with variable intensity
IHC (marker not labeled): diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining in nearly all tumor cells
IHC (marker not labeled): nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in nearly all tumor cells
IHC (marker not labeled): weak, patchy staining; most tumor cells largely negative
FISH: MYC and BCL2 break-apart probes each showing one fused and one split red/green signal, indicating rearrangement of both genes

48.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被取代，低倍下可見大量粉紅色上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes）成簇分布；高倍下其間散布小至中型、核不規則的淋巴細胞，並侵犯結節周圍脂肪。免疫染色顯示大量 T 細胞與顆粒狀細胞毒性標記陽性，符合 Lennert lymphoma（淋巴上皮樣型 PTCL）。
features: Effaced nodal architecture with a diffuse infiltrate punctuated by numerous small confluent clusters of epithelioid histiocytes (pale eosinophilic areas at low power)
Small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated nuclei and mildly clumped chromatin; occasional larger cells and mitoses
Epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei, without well-formed granulomas or necrosis
Extension of the infiltrate into perinodal fibroadipose tissue
IHC: many small-medium lymphocytes with membranous T-cell-type staining and weaker staining of background histiocytes (markers unlabeled)
Granular cytoplasmic dot staining consistent with a cytotoxic granule marker (TIA-1/granzyme pattern) in numerous cells
48.describe_en: Lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by a diffuse infiltrate with a mottled appearance due to numerous small clusters of epithelioid histiocytes, and the infiltrate extends into the perinodal adipose tissue. At high power, the lymphoid population consists predominantly of small to medium-sized cells with irregular nuclear contours, admixed with scattered larger cells and mitotic figures, set among abundant epithelioid histiocytes; well-formed granulomas and necrosis are not seen. Immunohistochemical stains (markers not labeled) highlight numerous T-cell-type lymphocytes with membranous staining, histiocytes with weak staining, and many cells with granular cytoplasmic positivity in a cytotoxic granule pattern. Findings are consistent with peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS, lymphoepithelioid (Lennert) variant.

ddx.vs: cHL contains diagnostic CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-weak HRS cells in a reactive background, whereas here the atypical small-medium T cells are the neoplastic population and HRS-like cells are rare and not the dominant lesional cell.

Reactive nodes preserve follicles and sinuses with non-atypical lymphocytes, whereas this node is effaced by atypical T cells extending into perinodal fat, supported by aberrant T-cell phenotype and clonal TCR rearrangement.
AITL shows arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded FDC meshworks and TFH-marker (PD1, CXCL13, ICOS) positive cells, features not dominant in this epithelioid histiocyte-rich infiltrate.
THRLBCL has scattered large CD20+ B cells in a T-cell/histiocyte background, whereas the lesional cells here are atypical small-medium T cells.

captions: IHC (marker unlabeled): membranous/cytoplasmic staining of numerous small-medium lymphocytes
Low-power H&E: effaced node with mottled pale clusters of epithelioid histiocytes
H&E: infiltrate extending into perinodal fibroadipose tissue
High-power H&E: irregular small-medium lymphoid cells among epithelioid histiocytes
IHC (marker unlabeled): membranous staining in lymphocytes with weak background histiocyte staining
IHC (marker unlabeled): scattered membranous-positive small-medium T-type lymphocytes
High-power IHC: granular cytoplasmic staining, cytotoxic granule pattern
IHC (marker unlabeled): strong staining of small lymphocytes with weak histiocyte staining (CD4-like pattern)
High-power IHC (marker unlabeled): weak membranous/cytoplasmic staining of larger histiocytoid cells

3312.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭指出多顆比周圍造血細胞大很多的腫瘤細胞，細胞質豐富、淡藍色且帶小空泡，核偏位、形狀不規則；這些散在的大型異型細胞代表未分化大細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）侵犯骨髓。
features: Scattered large atypical cells (arrows), several times the size of adjacent myeloid precursors
Abundant pale to moderately basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles, some with a perinuclear clearing
Eccentric round to irregular or reniform nuclei with moderately dispersed chromatin
Cells occur singly and in loose small groups rather than cohesive clusters
Background of normal granulocytic precursors, neutrophils, and red cells
3312.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large atypical cells, highlighted by arrows, lying singly and in loose small groups among normal maturing granulocytic elements. These cells have abundant pale-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and eccentric, round to irregular nuclei with dispersed chromatin; classic horseshoe-shaped hallmark nuclei are not clearly resolved at this magnification. Marrow involvement by ALCL is often subtle and better appreciated on the core biopsy with CD30 and ALK immunostains. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with molding and are keratin positive, whereas ALCL cells are discohesive and CD30/ALK positive.
Macrophages contain phagocytosed debris with low N:C ratio, and osteoblasts have an eccentric nucleus with a distinct hof and are CD30 negative.
Monoblasts are more numerous and uniform with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and are nonspecific esterase and CD33/CD64 positive.
Reed-Sternberg cells are rare in an aspirate, bilobed with inclusion-like nucleoli, CD15 positive, and ALK negative.

4208.recognize_zh: 高倍免疫組織化學染色中，許多中至大型淋巴樣細胞的細胞質呈顆粒狀、點狀棕色陽性，核為淡藍色、染色質細緻；標記未標明，型態像細胞毒性顆粒（如 TIA-1、granzyme B）染色，符合傳染性單核球增多症中活化的細胞毒性 T 細胞。
features: Many medium to large lymphoid cells with oval to irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Brown chromogen in a coarse granular/dot-like cytoplasmic pattern, often perinuclear
Staining intensity varies from scattered fine granules to dense clumps
Hematoxylin-counterstained negative cells intermixed; marker identity not provided
4208.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antigen not specified) on the splenic lesion shows a dense population of medium to large lymphoid cells with vesicular oval nuclei. A substantial subset shows granular, dot-like cytoplasmic positivity, a pattern characteristic of cytotoxic granule proteins such as TIA-1 or granzyme B, while other cells are negative. Because the marker is not stated, the exact lineage cannot be confirmed from this image alone. In context, the findings are suggestive of an expanded activated cytotoxic T-cell population, as seen in infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: NK/T-cell lymphoma also expresses cytotoxic granules but shows angiocentric necrosis, CD56 positivity and diffuse EBER positivity of the atypical cells rather than scattered EBER-positive immunoblasts.
HSTCL is a monotonous sinusoidal TIA-1-positive, granzyme B-negative gamma-delta T-cell proliferation, not a polymorphous reactive infiltrate.
CD30 gives membranous plus single paranuclear Golgi dot staining, not multiple coarse cytoplasmic granules.

65136.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆嗜中性球，其中左側細胞在核葉旁的細胞質內有一至兩顆小而圓、深紫色、與核染色一致的點狀包涵體，外觀類似紅血球的 Howell-Jolly body；背景紅血球多呈棘狀（crenation），多屬抹片乾燥假影。
features: Two mature neutrophils with segmented nuclei and fine pink-lilac cytoplasmic granules
Left neutrophil contains small, round, dense dark-purple inclusions in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nuclear lobes, staining like nuclear chromatin
Right neutrophil shows a lobulated nucleus with clumped chromatin without a clearly separate inclusion
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes), consistent with drying/storage artifact
Scattered normal-appearing platelets; no blasts in this field
65136.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature neutrophils with normal cytoplasmic granulation. One neutrophil contains small, round, dense, dark-purple cytoplasmic inclusions separate from the main nuclear lobes, resembling Howell-Jolly bodies (detached nuclear fragments). The background red cells show prominent crenation consistent with smear or storage artifact, and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions in neutrophils, a nonspecific finding reported with immunosuppressive or cytotoxic therapy (e.g., mycophenolate, tacrolimus, chemotherapy), HIV infection, and transplantation; correlation with medication history is recommended.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, irregular, peripheral cytoplasmic patches of rough ER rather than dense, round, chromatin-colored dots.
A drumstick is attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin chromatin strand, whereas Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions lie free in the cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed bacteria or organisms (e.g., Ehrlichia/Anaplasma morulae)
ddx.vs: Morulae are stippled clusters of basophilic granules and bacteria are rod- or coccus-shaped, unlike solitary smooth round nuclear fragments.
Apoptotic cells show multiple uniformly pyknotic, round nuclear fragments with condensed cytoplasm rather than an otherwise normal segmented nucleus with a small detached fragment.
